title: Detention Center Chief
description:
SPECIFIC DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

The Chief of Security is responsible for all security duties that are directly related to housing and security operations functions at the Detention Center and serves as the second-line supervisor of all employees in the Security Division. As part of those duties and responsibilities, the Chief of Security assists the Director of Detention and the Assistant Director of Detention in the development and monitoring of the Security Division, including:

  • Overseeing all security measures at the Detention Center, including surveillance systems, perimeter security, and inmate movement to prevent escapes, violence, and contraband.

  • Helping to develop and implement comprehensive security policies and procedures to mitigate risks and address evolving security challenges.

  • Conducting regular security audits and assessments to identify vulnerabilities and implement improvements.

  • Helping coordinate and lead response efforts during emergencies such as riots, natural disasters, medical emergencies, or security breaches.

  • Assisting in working with local law enforcement, fire departments, and other emergency responders to ensure a coordinated response during critical incidents.
  • Helping monitor and enforce compliance with the Detention Center’s security standards and internal policies.

  • Maintaining up-to-date records related to security activities, incidents, and staffing.

  • Overseeing the installation, maintenance, and operation of surveillance equipment, including cameras, alarm systems, and access control systems.

  • Leveraging technology to monitor inmate activity, identify security threats, and improve operational efficiency.

  • Working closely with facility leadership to ensure the safety and well-being of inmates, staff, and visitors.

  • Leading, supervising, and training a team of security staff, including:

  • Ensuring that all Security personnel receive the appropriate training and required certification(s) in their areas of responsibility.
  • Ensuring that all Security personnel receive mandatory re-certification training.
  • Directly monitoring and supervising the work performance of personnel assigned to the Security function.
  • Overseeing work assignments and schedules.
  • Reviewing and evaluating work performed.
  • Resolving personnel problems and assists in other employee related matters as required.

The Chief of Security also performs other duties as assigned by the Assistant Director of Detention or his designee.

MINIMUM EDUCATION AND TRAINING

VOCATIONAL/EDUCATIONAL PREPARATION:

Requires an Associate’s degree; Bachelor’s degree preferred.

SPECIAL CERTIFICATIONS AND LICENSES:

Must possess a valid state driver’s license.

Must meet other requirements as set forth in applicable South Carolina statutes and regulations.

Must possess Class II officer certification or be able to obtain certification from the SC Criminal Justice Academy within six (6) months of hire.

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

Minimum of eight (8) years of experience in a law enforcement or correctional setting, with at least 3-5 years in a leadership or supervisory role in security or corrections.

Experience working in a detention facility is preferred but not required.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS AND STANDARDS REQUIRED

Data Involvement: Requires gathering, organizing, analyzing, examining or evaluating data or information and may prescribe action based on such data or information.

People Involvement: Requires strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively interact with detainees, staff, and the public.

Involvement with Things: Requires leading, operating or repairing complex machinery or equipment that requires extended training and experience, such as police vehicles and equipment, firearms. Involves operations of limited scope; proficiency in the use of security technology, including surveillance systems, access controls, and alarm systems.

Reasoning Requirements: Requires performing skilled work involving rules/systems with almost constant problem-solving. Requires strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Mathematical Requirements: Requires using addition and subtraction, multiplication and division, and/or calculating ratios, rates and percentages.

Language Requirements: Requires reading technical instructions, procedures, manuals and charts to solve practical problems; composing routine reports and specialized reports, forms and business letters with proper format; speaking compound sentences using normal grammar and word form.

Mental Requirements: Requires doing clerical, manual or technical tasks requiring a wide range of procedures and requiring intensive understanding of a restricted field or complete familiarity with the functions of a unit or small division of an operating agency; requires normal attention with short periods of concentration for accurate results or occasional exposure to unusual pressure. Requires strong knowledge of security management, risk assessment, and emergency response techniques.

Judgments and Decisions: Responsible for guiding others, requiring frequent decisions affecting co-workers and others who depend on the service or product; works in a fluid environment with rules and procedures but with many variations from the routine; ability to work under pressure and make sound decisions during high-stress situations.

Compensation Range: $87,956.82 - $140,612.18

title: Backend Engineer
description:
Overview

The Backend Engineer on the AI Platform team plays a critical role in building and evolving the backend systems that power internal products, customer-facing capabilities, AI-enabled workflows, and operational decision-making across the organization. This role is responsible for designing, building, testing, and operating reliable, scalable, and flexible services that support a wide range of internal and external use cases. This role contributes to the development and evolution of core backend and distributed systems capabilities, including service-oriented architectures, APIs, workflow orchestration, event-driven integrations, identity and permissions, operational tooling, and system interfaces that enable product, data, and AI teams to move quickly. Success requires strong technical depth, sound systems thinking, and the ability to build dependable solutions in a cloud-based, regulated, high-stakes environment. The Backend Engineer is expected to operate effectively in a modern engineering environment, using automation, observability, CI/CD, testing, and infrastructure-as-code practices to deploy, manage, and improve production services. In parallel, this individual will help enable downstream product capabilities, operational workflows, reporting, and AI systems by ensuring that backend services are trustworthy, maintainable, and performant. This is a fully remote position that offers a competitive salary range of $140,000 to $240,000 USD, plus an annual bonus. You'll also receive our excellent benefits package, which includes medical coverage starting on day one and a company-matched 401(k). Compensation may vary based on experience, location, and other job-related factors.

Responsibilities

Scale High-Performance Distributed Systems

  • Design, build, and maintain production backend services for a wide variety of internal and external use cases, including product workflows, operational tools, integrations, APIs, and AI-enabled applications
  • Develop well-structured APIs, domain models, service interfaces, and business logic that are easy to understand, test, operate, and extend
  • Build scalable backend workflows that support complex business processes across loans, documents, accounts, users, permissions, vendors, and operational decision making
  • Ensure backend services are reliable, testable, observable, and resilient as business needs, data volumes, and product surfaces evolve

Systems Architecture & Integration

  • Contribute to service architectures that support transactional, operational, analytical, and AI-driven workloads across production environments
  • Integrate with internal systems, third‑party platforms, vendor APIs, databases, files, message queues, event streams, and cloud services
  • Design patterns for service boundaries, idempotency, consistency, retries, failure handling, schema evolution, versioning, and backward compatibility
  • Help define practical architecture standards that balance speed, simplicity, reliability, security, and long‑term maintainability

Cloud Deployment & Operations

  • Deploy, operate, and improve backend services on major cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure
  • Use infrastructure‑as‑code, CI/CD, automated testing, and deployment automation to improve release speed, consistency, and reliability
  • Monitor production services using logging, tracing, metrics, alerting, and observability tools to proactively identify and resolve issues
  • Support secure, resilient, and cost‑conscious operation of cloud‑based backend infrastructure and application services

Reliability, Security & Compliance

  • Build systems with strong operational discipline, including attention to latency, availability, scalability, correctness, incident response, and production support
  • Implement authentication, authorization, permissions, audit logging, data protection, and secure service‑to‑service communication patterns
  • Establish and maintain standards for API documentation, service ownership, runbooks, operational metrics, change management, and production readiness
  • Contribute to practices that support security, privacy, auditability, compliance, and risk management in a regulated environment

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, AI, Design, Operations, and business stakeholders to understand workflows, user needs, constraints, and delivery priorities
  • Translate business and operational requirements into clean, scalable, maintainable, and secure backend solutions
  • Support downstream consumers of backend capabilities, including product teams, analysts, researchers, AI systems, operational users, and external integrations
  • Communicate clearly with both technical and non‑technical stakeholders about system behavior, tradeoffs, risks, dependencies, and delivery timelines

Iteration & Continuous Improvement

  • Continuously improve service performance, reliability, scalability, security, and developer productivity
  • Identify opportunities to simplify architecture, reduce operational toil, improve shared platform leverage, and make systems easier to reason about
  • Operate with a strong bias toward action and iterative delivery, moving quickly from problem definition to implementation, validation, and improvement
  • Help raise the bar on engineering quality through thoughtful design, code review, testing, documentation, mentorship, and operational discipline

Qualifications

  • 3‑5+ years of experience building and operating production‑grade backend systems, APIs, services, or distributed applications
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, system design, debugging, testing, and code quality
  • Experience designing, building, maintaining, and debugging services that run in production and support real users or business‑critical workflows
  • Experience with modern backend programming languages such as Python, Go, C++, Rust, Java, Kotlin, Scala, TypeScript, or C#
  • Experience with API design, service boundaries, event‑driven or asynchronous architectures, relational data stores, and non‑relational data stores
  • Experience building transactional systems where correctness, idempotency, consistency, reconciliation, and auditability matter
  • Experience deploying and operating backend services on major cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure
  • Strong SQL skills and comfort with application data modeling, schema evolution, migrations, query performance, and data access patterns
  • Experience building AI‑powered capabilities on top of LLMs, including orchestration, retrieval, evaluation, tool integrations, and workflow automation
  • Comfort working with CI/CD, infrastructure‑as‑code, observability, incident response, and production operations for backend systems
  • Strong judgment in ambiguous environments where requirements evolve and systems must balance speed, reliability, security, and flexibility
  • Clear communication skills with both technical and non‑technical teammates

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in fintech, mortgage, lending, payments, insurance, banking, capital markets, or other regulated domains
  • Experience with queues, streaming, and event‑driven platforms such as Kafka, Kinesis, SQS/SNS, Pub/Sub, RabbitMQ, or similar systems
  • Experience building secure identity, access control, permissions, audit trail, policy, or compliance‑oriented backend capabilities
  • Experience building high‑volume, low‑latency, multi‑tenant, B2B, enterprise, or internal platform systems
  • Experience building AI products, developer platforms, workflow automation systems, or LLM‑powered enterprise applications
  • Experience improving system reliability, cost efficiency, developer productivity, and operational scalability as a platform grows

Note to candidates

You do not need prior fintech or finance experience to succeed in this role. If you are a strong backend engineer with solid technical judgment, a product mindset, and excitement for solving complex systems problems, we would love to hear from you.

If your background does not line up perfectly with every bullet, but this role feels like the kind of work you want to do, please apply.

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
About the role

We're building a team to make migration a core capability of our Legal platform. This team will create an AI-accelerated migration platform that helps law firms move onto our platform with greater speed, confidence, and predictability. This is a ground-up platform build, and we're hiring the Technical Product Manager to own its product direction, roadmap, and priorities. The role is ideal for a product leader who wants to turn complex migration challenges into a repeatable, scalable platform capability.


You will turn migration and onboarding problems into well-scoped product opportunities, set priorities with the team, and stay accountable for measurable customer and business outcomes. You will work closely with the Engineering Tech Lead, who owns technical architecture, and partner with migration and operations teams that bring deep customer and delivery context.

What you'll do

  • Own the product direction, roadmap, and prioritization for the migration platform.
  • Develop deep knowledge of the Legal data model and how it maps to application behavior, workflows, and customer outcomes.
  • Gain an in-depth understanding of legal practice management and accounting, including the workflows, customer problems, and data relationships Legal solves and supports.
  • Shape ambiguous problems into clearly scoped, buildable work with the Engineering Tech Lead, making disciplined tradeoffs around scope, value, and time.
  • Own committed product work through delivery, making deliberate scope tradeoffs when new information or complexity emerges.
  • Translate customer and operational needs into product priorities, balancing time-to-value, delivery capacity, platform investment, and customer commitments.
  • Define and track measures of migration success, including time-to-value, cutover experience, delivery predictability, quality, and customer outcomes.
  • Partner closely with migration advisors, delivery teams, customers, and engineering so real-world migrationexperience shapes product decisions early.
  • Develop product strategy that turns recurring migration challenges into durable platform capabilities.

What we’re looking for

  • 6+ years in product management, including substantial experience with technical or data-intensive products such as platforms, integrations, migration systems, developer tooling, or workflow infrastructure.
  • A track record of owning product direction and outcomes on a high-performing technical team, from problemdefinition through delivery and iteration.
  • Strong technical fluency and the ability to engage deeply with engineers on data flows, system behavior, architecture, constraints and tradeoffs.
  • Strong judgment about scope. You would rather ship a smaller thing that works than a bigger thing that slips.
  • Clear, direct written communication. You can make a sharp case for what to build, what not to build, and why.
  • Experience working across engineering, operations, delivery, and customer-facing teams where prioritiescompete and tradeoffs have real consequences.

Nice to have

  • Experience in legal, fintech, healthcare, or another domain with high standards for correctness, confidentiality, and compliance.
  • Familiarity with modern data architecture concepts including data pipelines, transformation, orchestration, APIs, and event-driven systems.
  • Experience taking a technical product or platform from concept through production launch and subsequentiteration.
  • Experience with enterprise onboarding, implementation, integrations, or data migration workflows.

How the team works

You’ll join a focused team inside our product and engineering organization, built to move quickly on a strategic platform capability. We work in short, fixed-length cycles with lightweight planning, clear ownership, and disciplined tradeoffs that keep delivery focused and predictable.

The Technical Product Manager and Engineering Tech Lead work as close partners: product leads problem definition, priorities, and outcomes; engineering leads technical architecture and implementation. Both have meaningful influence over sequencing and scope, with direct access to the migration and operational teams closest to our customers.

Applying for a role with WMCA is straightforward. Follow these steps to get started.

  1. Create your Careers Account. Register with your name, email address, and a password.
  2. Build your Profile. Upload your CV to help populate your career and education details.

Applications that rely too heavily on AI may be rejected during shortlisting. For help on how to write a supporting statement, please visit the FAQs section of our careers site.

title: Full Stack Engineer - Hybrid
description:
Overview

Build What Matters

The Full Stack Engineer is an ownership role responsible for product outcomes end-to-end: from shaping technical approaches and building features through to release, reliability, and production performance.

At Sitemate, engineers combine strong technical craft with product thinking and delivery ownership. You'll work in small, high-trust teams alongside Product Design Managers to define problems, shape solutions, implement clean and scalable systems, and take responsibility for what ships — including how it behaves once live.

Engineering, product, and delivery are not separate handoffs here; they operate as one integrated team. We believe the future of product development in an AI-accelerated world belongs to engineers who can think beyond tickets - they own outcomes and deliver at speed with AI.

Employment

Full-time

Based: Sydney, Australia or Melbourne, Australia

Remuneration (Including Super): AUD $115,000 - $160,000 pending your experience

About Sitemate

Sitemate builds modern software for construction, infrastructure, and industrial companies - helping teams move faster, work smarter, and deliver with confidence.

Our flagship platform, Dashpivot, transforms manual, paper-based processes into simple, mobile-first digital workflows. Teams use Sitemate every day to capture data in the field, automate reporting, and make better decisions in real time.

Since launching in 2018, we’ve grown from 5 to 150+ people across 18+ countries. We’re backed by Blackbird, Australia and New Zealand’s #1 venture capital firm, and graduated from the Startmate Accelerator. Thousands of companies use Sitemate tools today - with thousands more discovering us each month through strong word-of-mouth and organic growth.

Why Join Sitemate

At Sitemate, you’ll join a global team that values transparency, high velocity, hustle, diversity, and innovation.

We’re open about our metrics, honest about challenges, and obsessed with improving how the world’s most important industries operate. Our environment is flexible, fast-moving, and outcome-driven - designed to help you do the best work of your career.

You’ll be surrounded by people who take pride in their work, care deeply about results, and believe that great culture is built on trust, respect, and continuous learning.

How We Work

Transparency at every level: Monthly Allhands meetings share key company metrics, updates, and customer stories. We also spotlight a team member’s “Life Story” each month - it’s one of the ways we stay connected as a global team.

High velocity, low friction: Our systems are modern and fully integrated, so you’ll spend your time solving problems - not fighting tools.

Performance-driven growth: Seven of our last ten pay increases were made proactively, based on impact and results.

True flexibility: We focus on outcomes, not hours. You’ll have autonomy to manage your time and work where you perform best - with no time monitoring or unnecessary meetings.

Collaboration: You’ll work closely with other teams - engineering, product, design, marketing, and customer success - to move fast and deliver meaningful results.

Sydney HQ perks - rooftop garden, wellness centre, showers, and cycle storage in Haymarket

Melbourne office perks - micro-roasted coffee bar, on-site parking & bike storage, wellness & mothers rooms, opposite Southern Cross station

What We Offer

Competitive, performance-based remuneration

Equity options - own a piece of what you’re helping to build

20 days of paid annual leave, plus sick, carer’s, and compassionate leave

  • Paid parental leave - 16 weeks for primary carers, 6 weeks for secondary carers (including adoption and stillbirth support)
  • Professional growth budget and a transparent career development framework
  • Laptop and home-office setup budget
  • Flexible work - remote or hybrid, plus the ability to work from anywhere for a few weeks each year
  • Community & connection - weekly team lunches, global offsites, and our signature “Life Story” sessions

Diversity & Inclusion

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Sitemate welcomes people of all genders, ethnicities, ages, sexualities, and abilities.

55% of our team identify as coming from underrepresented ethnic backgrounds, 43% identify as female, and our team spans ages 22–51. We believe our diversity makes us stronger - and we’re committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work.

Learn More About Sitemate

Podcasts:

  • 2024: CEO Hartley Pike on scaling Sitemate, diversity, and culture
  • 2023: CMO Lance Hodgson on accelerating your career
  • 2022: CTO Tim Bray on building quality features that solve real customer problems

Want to know what it’s like to work at Sitemate? Hear it straight from the team: People of Sitemate

Read what our customers say: G2 Crowd, Trust Radius

Team Offsites: 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025

What this role looks like at the mid level

  • You’ll join a team attached to one of our products and have real ownership from early on, with the support of experienced engineers around you.
  • You’ll work across frontend, backend, and mobile: TypeScript, React, Node.js, Angular, MongoDB, and AWS. You don't need to know all of these, willingness to learn matters more than what you know today.

Day-to-Day

  • Build and ship features with guidance from experienced teammates.
  • Work with AI tools daily, with the team's workflow skills for planning, implementation and review.
  • Fix bugs and improve product stability across web and mobile.
  • Investigate and resolve production issues.
  • Grow into more ownership over time, this role expands as you do.

Challenges

  • Our products seem simple to users but contain a high degree of technical complexity — shared components across multiple products, backend services powering web and mobile clients. There's a lot to learn.
  • Pace: we move quickly, so you'll need to be excited to learn fast.
  • We have a strong culture based on core values and operating principles. You may need to unlearn some habits from previous experience.

Who This Role is For

  • You've built things you're proud of at a startup, in a side project, during a bootcamp, or at university.
  • You're deeply curious about AI-powered development and want to learn agentic engineering in a production environment.
  • You want to understand the customer problem, not just the code.
  • You're energised by learning fast in a supportive, high-tempo environment.
  • You want to be part of building something meaningful — our users build real infrastructure that shapes communities.

Who This Role is Not For

  • You prefer a slow ramp with months of onboarding before touching production code — here you'll ship early, with support.
  • You're not interested in owning the end-to-end delivery of features.
  • You're not interested in AI-first engineering practices, this is core to how we work, not optional.

Skills & Tools

Must Have:

  • Solid hands‑on experience building and shipping production software
  • Hands on experience with AI-powered developer tools and agentic engineering practices
  • Product mindset — wants to understand customer problems, not just implement tickets
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of features end-to-end

Nice to Have:

  • TypeScript, React, Node.js, Angular, MongoDB, or AWS experience
  • Mobile development experience
  • Experience working in a fast-paced startup or product environment

Essential Tools:

  • TypeScript / JavaScript
  • React or Angular
  • Node.js

Bonus Tools:

  • MongoDB
  • AWS
  • React Native / mobile

title: Snowshoe Guide
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: SNOWSHOE GUIDE

POSITION: Snowshoe Guide

REPORTS TO: Evergreen Backcountry Guides Director

DEPARTMENT: Evergreen Backcountry Guides (EBG)


POSITION SUMMARY:

Snowshoe guides will lead guests into snowshoe accessed wilderness areas, national park areas, and trail networks in and around the Hakuba Valley. Snowshoe guides will work within the framework of our backcountry tour operations office, Evergreen Backcountry Guides (EBG)


POSITION DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Our guides are responsible for the safety, wellbeing, and enjoyment of guests out on snowshoe tours. Guides should have snowshoe/hiking/trekking experience, route finding skills, strong leadership and communication skills, Wilderness First Aid skills, avalanche rescue skills and winter rescue training.

  • Guides will be expected to safely manage groups in snowshoe tour terrain, create ascent and descent routes, manage tour time to leave and return in acceptable times, cater to guests needs and abilities in the field, find safe yet fun and satisfying terrain for that particular day and area.

  • Guides will be expected to understand and record pertinent data in their logbooks. Guides will be expected to fill out when required; trip plan forms, rental equipment forms, vehicle accident report forms, emergency /accident /injury report forms.

  • Guides will be expected to potentially “mentor” trainee guides or new EBG guides to teach them terrain, tour flow, tour locations, tour, and guest management, and guiding practices.

  • Guides will also drive company van's to and from tour locations. Guides will fill up and receive receipts for gasoline, clean off snow/ice from exterior, clean trash from interior. Guides will be expected to check and refill if needed: for oil levels and wind shield wiper fluid and let their manager know if EBG vehicles have any mechanical issues. Guides will be expected to follow Japan road and driving laws, drive defensively, change tires (if flat tires w/ spare) and park company vehicles in appropriate areas.

  • Guides will be expected to follow our duty of care to our guests from tour start to tour end. Guides will be expected to provide first aid, rescue action, rescue leadership, rescue communications, rescue/evacuation plans and strategy and total group care while on the tour. Guides will also be expected to respond to 3rd party or other parties’ emergencies/rescues/accidents if assistance is available, feasible and does not compromise the safety/care of our guests.

  • Guides will be expected to have and carry company cell phone and radio on their person during all tours and to be reachable after office hours. A GPS device is also a great addition, but not mandatory.

  • Guides should have a friendly personality and show enthusiasm for guiding.

  • Guides will be expected to establish a professional rapport with guests to instill confidence and trust.

  • Guides should also possess solid organizational skills and have effective communication skills.

  • Guides will be expected to participate in company required in-house and in-the-field training.

JOB DUTIES MAY ALSO INCLUDE:


Snow clearing, tidying up front and back of office space, replacing and or fixing rental gear and equipment, assisting with staff accommodation and personal room clean-up /maintenance, picking up and dropping off guests at locations within Hakuba/Nagano, replying to emails or providing information to our admin staff regarding guest’s situations or guests’ conditions/sentiment/feelings/feedback.

ADDITIONAL DUTIES:


Due to the many variables that affect business operations, occasionally, employees may be asked to perform other duties or assist in efforts outside their primary area of responsibility, when admin staff deems it necessary. This may include performing in any subordinate position.


SUPERVISORY DUTIES:

Supervise new staff or new guides with daily operations and provide training to new staff or new guides. Rental set up training, rope rescue training, avalanche rescue training, driving training, route, and tour terrain training.

GENERAL DUTIES:

Leading or assisting half day or full day snowshoe tours, leading, or assisting evening snowshoe tours. Potential to lead or assist Cross-country Ski Tours (Nordic ski). Prepare personal gear and guest gear for all their tours.

DAILY:

Leading or assisting full day snowshoe tours, leading, or assisting evening snowshoe tours. Plan, adjust and maintain group management, and guest safety from tour start to end. Cleaning off and preparing company vehicles, driving, and picking up guests, checking vehicles gas levels and refueling. Carrying snowshoe tour gear/equipment/ drinks/snacks/food on tours. Providing snowshoe boots, hot drinks, and snacks and/or lunch to guests on tours. Resetting and drying snowshoe gear, washing tour utensils/cups/thermos’s/plates/bowls etc., resetting and purchasing tour tea/coffee/snack supplies. Using radio and/or cell phone to communicate with office.

WEEKLY:

Monitor rental gear for maintenance, repair or retiring. Follow staff housing/accommodation cleaning rosters and attend meetings for guides/staff housing.

MONTHLY:

Attend company meetings.


SEASONAL:

Attend company pre-season or mid-season trainings, and end-of season meetings. Receive and return any EBG ID cards, Season’s passes, radios, cell phone & chargers, maps, and uniform.

PREREQUISITES:



  • Wilderness First Aid: 20-hour course (minimum) and valid certification.

  • Japanese Driver’s License or International Driver’s License.

  • High level of fitness, comfortable and capable to lead tours in all snow and weather conditions and on all terrain (snow = powder, crud, ice, slush), (weather = clear/sunny, snowing/blizzard/ windy, rainy, (terrain = trees and forest terrain, alpine bowls, gullies, creek crossings, snow bridges, crossing avalanche slide paths, etc.).

  • Extensive personal hiking/touring/trekking experience.

  • Map/Compass/GPS usage & route-finding skills/ navigation skills and experience.

FAVORABLE QUALIFICATIONS (not pre-requisites but valuable assets/experience):



  • Other Outdoor Guide/Instructor/ Leader Certification.

  • Tour Guide/Tour Guest Service Expérience.

  • Naturalist /Biologist/Ecologist /Interpretive guide.

  • Avalanche Safety Course/training education/experience.

  • Hiking guiding experience/internship/training.

  • Other instructor certification /experience.

  • Ski Patrol Experience.

POSITION COMPETENCIES

The following competencies may be demonstrated in this position, among others:


  • Analytical - Synthesizing diverse information, using intuition and experience to complement data. Demonstrating attention to detail.

  • Problem Solving - Identifying and resolving problems in a timely manner. Gathering and analyzing information skillfully. Using reason even when dealing with emotional topics.

  • Customer Service - Managing difficult or emotional customer situations. Responding promptly to customer needs. Responding to requests for service and assistance.

  • Interpersonal Skills - Focusing on solving conflict, not blaming. Maintaining confidentiality Listening to others without interrupting. Keeping emotions under control.

  • Oral Communication - Speaking clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations Listening and getting clarification. Responding well to questions. Demonstrating group presentation skills. Participating in meetings.

  • Organizational Support - Following policies and procedures. Supporting Evergreen goals and values.

  • Judgement - Exhibiting sound and accurate judgment.

  • Planning/ Organizing - Prioritizing and planning work activities. Using time efficiently.

  • Professionalism - Approaching others in a tactful manner. Reacting well under pressure Treating others with respect and consideration, regardless of their status or position. Accepting responsibility for own actions.

  • Quality/ Quantity - Demonstrating accuracy and thoroughness. Monitoring own work to ensure quality. Completing work in a timely manner.

  • Safety and Security - Observing safety and security procedures. Determining appropriate action beyond guidelines. Reporting potentially unsafe conditions. Using equipment and materials properly.

  • Adaptability - Adapting to changes in the work environment. Ability to deal with frequent change, delays, or unexpected events.

  • Dependability - Is consistently at work and on time. Following instructions, responds to management direction. Taking responsibility for own actions. Committing to long hours of work when necessary to reach goals. Attending required staff meetings.

  • Initiative - Volunteering readily; asking for and offers help when needed.


Additional tasks not enumerated in this job description may be assigned. Reasonable requests by Management are considered valid job assignments.

title: Project Manager
description:
About Scope

Looking for work with real purpose?

Scope’s purpose is to create meaningful opportunities for people with disability to belong and thrive.

As the national industry leader, we support people with physical, intellectual and multiple disabilities to achieve their goals. Scope is a registered provider under the NDIS and delivers a range of services including supported independent living, therapy and employment services in over 420 service locations across Victoria and NSW.

We are currently undertaking a significant transformation program across our organisation and this includes leveraging and embedding modern technologies and innovation.

This has created an exciting opportunity for a Project Manager to join us on our journey! This is a 12 month FTC.

You will have led delivery of projects with a strong technology component & be looking to bring your technical skills and experience to an environment where you can make a difference to people's lives.

Reporting to the Enterprise Delivery Manager, you will work on technology led initiatives spanning the breadth of our organisation and may include AI, software and specialised applications.

About Your Role

The Project Manager plays a critical role in delivering Scope’s enterprise strategic priority initiatives. Sitting within the Enterprise Project Management Office (ePMO) this role leads the planning, execution, and delivery of high-impact projects that span multiple business units and contribute directly to Scope’s transformation agenda.

Reporting to the Enterprise Delivery Manager, this role serves as the strategic anchor for project execution - driving clarity, accountability, and momentum across the full project lifecycle.

The role can be based out of either our Hawthorn (Vic) or Kingsgrove (NSW) Office based on a hybrid (3 day a week on-site) model working arrangement.

Your Key Focus

As a direct report to the Enterprise Delivery Manager.

Some of your responsibilities will include:

  • Lead end-to-end execution of strategic projects, ensuring alignment with Scope’s strategic priorities and transformation goals
  • Define and manage project scope, schedule, budgets to ensure all are delivered on time, on budget and benefits realised
  • Track and manage risks, issues and dependencies, ensuring proactive mitigation and escalation where needed
  • Ensure compliance with ePMO frameworks, templates, and reporting protocols across the project lifecycle, acting as a champion for best practice
  • Collaborate with sponsors and key stakeholders to develop and maintain benefit realisation plans aligned to the enterprise benefit management framework, including benefit registers and tracking mechanisms, with clear ownership and measurable indicators of success.
  • Build trusted relationships with key stakeholders (sponsors, business owners, SMEs and vendors) to support project success
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and facilitate decision-making through structured governance and reporting

Your Technical Capabilities

  • Demonstrated experience in leading end-to-end delivery of complex, cross-functional projects within a structured PMO or ePMO environment
  • Proven ability to manage stakeholder relationships at all levels, including executive sponsors, business owners, and delivery teams
  • Strong understanding of project governance, risk, and benefit management frameworks, with experience applying them in practice
  • Proficiency in project management tools and reporting platforms (e.g., Monday.com, MS Project, Power BI)

Scope as an Employer

At Scope, we ‘Celebrate our people’ by rewarding you with access to an exclusive benefits platform. You will have access to cashback, vouchers, and discounts to over 500 popular retailers covering groceries, fuel, entertainment, wellbeing and so much more. It’s one of the ways we thank our team for the ongoing and valued contribution they make to the lives of the people we support.

View our stance on inclusion, diversity and human rights by visiting our careers page.

Benefits:

  • Meaningful work that creates positive impact for people with disability
  • Flexible working arrangements, with a minimum of three days per week at a Scope location
  • Collaborative and supportive team environment
  • Opportunities to influence organisation-wide transformation initiatives
  • Salary packaging benefits of up to $15,900 per year
  • Free onsite and accessible parking
  • Hawthorn office is nearby public transport

Scope (Aust) is a 2026 Circle Back Initiative Employer – we commit to respond to every applicant.

No Agencies: Whilst we appreciate your interest, we are confident we can find a great candidate without external support.

Take your career on a journey with Scope and work proactively with us to achieve our purpose!

If at any time you require us to adjust our recruitment process to meet your individual needs please email careers@scopeaust.org.au

Please note, successful applicants will be required to hold a NDIS Worker Screening Check Clearance and a Working with Children Check. If you have lived or worked for a continuous period of 12 months or more in another country within the last 10 years, a certified International Police Check from that country or countries will also be required. Please note that the offer will be conditional on meeting these requirements.

description:
Professional Senior, Engineering, Data Governance/Management

When applicable, Bombardier promotes flexible and hybrid work policies.

Why join us?

At Bombardier, we design, build and maintain the world’s peak-performing aircraft for the world’s most discerning people and businesses, governments and militaries. We have been successful in setting the highest standards by putting our people at the heart of it all, and defining excellence, together.

Working at Bombardier means operating at the highest level. Every day, you are part of a team that delivers superior experiences and products, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in our industry and beyond. By prioritizing employee growth and development, we empower everyone to reach their full potential on their own terms, because the best work happens when you are free to be yourself and share your unique expertise.

Bombardier’s Benefits Program

  • Insurance plans (Dental, medical, life insurance, disability, and more)
  • Competitive base salary
  • Retirement savings plan
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Tele Health Program

What are your contributions to the team?

  • Develop and maintain Data Governance/Management policies and guidelines;
  • Promote data integration and standardization across business units, processes and systems;
  • Develop and lead the Data Knowledge Domain;
  • Assess the state of engineering data within ERP and PLM systems;
  • Identify opportunities for improving data management and recommend solutions;
  • Actively collaborate with domain knowledge owner and stakeholders to implement or improve business processes;
  • Develop and perform audit reports;
  • Develop and publish reports on Intranet sites;
  • Prepare and execute ad-hoc data extract request (SQL and SAP);
  • Own and maintain SQL engineering database requirements;
  • Proactively identify and resolve data related problems;
  • Provide expertise and technical guidance in troubleshooting problems reported by end-user(s);
  • Able to investigate errors back to the root cause;
  • Assist functional teams the understanding the product definition, configuration and release within ERP and PLM systems;
  • Plan and execute data addition, alignment, migration and correction within PLM and ERP systems;
  • Develop and maintain documentation with regard to BM’s, KPI’s, reports and “How To”;
  • Collect, organize and document requirements of engineering tables, objects, security, interfaces, configuration within SAP;
  • Collaborate or review/approve IT projects solution.

How to thrive in this role?

  • You have a university or college degree/diploma;
  • You have acquired at least five (5) years of experience in a similar role;
  • You have advanced knowledge in configuration management, product definition and release process;
  • You have a general knowledge of engineering data/documents consumers;
  • You have a good understanding of Data Management and Governance principles;
  • You demonstrate initiative and independence in carrying out multiple tasks under a continuously evolving and changing environment;
  • You have good networking skills with peers or cross functional business units;
  • You have strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills;
  • You have a working knowledge of SAP, ENOVIA, Datalink, BDI and Teamcenter and understand how engineering data is consumed and secured within these systems (an asset);
  • You love to work with large scale data analysis and mining;
  • You have a working knowledge of SQL;
  • You are proficient in Word, Excel, Visio and PowerPoint;
  • You have strong verbal and written English communication and presentation skills – Effectively communicate with non-technical and interdisciplinary teams. French communication skills are desired.

Please note: You don’t need all the skills, knowledge, and experience listed to apply for this position. We’re not looking for the perfect candidate, we’re looking for great talent and passionate individuals.

Bombardier is an equal opportunity employer and encourages persons of any race, religion, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, immigration status, disability or other applicable legally protected characteristics to apply.

title: Senior Cloud & AI Security Enablement Engineer
description:
Senior Cloud & AI Security Enablement Engineer

Enthusiastic about securing cloud platforms and AI-driven solutions in a rapidly evolving technology landscape?
Do you enjoy designing security frameworks, enabling secure development practices, and partnering with engineering teams to build resilient, scalable, and compliant cloud and AI environments?

About the team:

LexisNexis Intellectual Property Solutions (LNIP) is the global leader in patent intelligence, bringing clarity to innovation for businesses, law firms, universities, and government agencies worldwide. Our mission is to help the innovation community make better decisions faster, with greater confidence, combining the world’s most trusted patent data with sophisticated analytics, AI-powered insights, and purpose-built workflows.

Protégé in PatentSight is LNIP’s next-generation agentic AI assistant, purpose-built for strategic patent analysis. Protégé replaces complex filter-based workflows with natural language questions, surfacing structured, decision-ready insights grounded in trusted data and established metrics.

About the role:

We are seeking a Senior Cloud & AI Security Enablement Engineer to provide hands-on cloud security engineering capability while also enabling the secure and effective use of AI across Information Security and product engineering teams.

This role sits between Security Architecture, BISO/Application Security, Cloud/Platform Engineering, and GRC. It is designed to reduce manual workload on Security Architecture and BISO/Application Security by turning recurring security requirements into reusable cloud guardrails, automated controls, AI-assisted workflows, secure design patterns, and developer-facing enablement materials.

The successful candidate will be a practical builder and security partner who can operate cloud security controls, support secure AI adoption, and use AI to improve the speed and consistency of security delivery.

Key Responsibilities:

Cloud Security Engineering

  • Build and maintain reusable cloud security guardrails for identity, logging, encryption, network segmentation, secrets management, storage, workloads, containers, serverless services, and data protection.

  • Translate security architecture standards into deployable cloud patterns, reference implementations, templates, and engineering-ready requirements.

  • Partner with cloud, platform, DevOps, and product engineering teams to embed security controls into cloud landing zones, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code workflows, and operational processes.

  • Support the implementation and tuning of CSPM, CNAPP, cloud workload protection, IaC scanning, secrets scanning, and related cloud security tooling.

  • Develop policy-as-code and control-as-code mechanisms to prevent, detect, and report common cloud misconfigurations.

  • Support cloud-native vulnerability and misconfiguration remediation by providing prioritization logic, remediation guidance, and reusable fix patterns.

  • Establish cloud security metrics and dashboards covering control adoption, misconfiguration trends, remediation progress, recurring issues, and exception patterns.

AI Security Enablement

  • Design and maintain AI-assisted workflows for security intake triage, threat model drafting, architecture review summaries, control mapping, remediation guidance, and risk statement generation.

  • Build prompt libraries, review rubrics, validation steps, and human-in-the-loop processes for approved AI use within Information Security.

  • Identify repetitive BISO, AppSec, and Security Architecture tasks that can be safely accelerated through AI-assisted processes.

  • Partner with GRC, Legal, Privacy, and security leadership to ensure AI-assisted security workflows are auditable, explainable, and aligned with internal risk expectations.

  • Measure the effectiveness of AI-assisted workflows, including time saved, consistency improvements, review quality, and reduction in repeat manual work.

Secure AI Application and Cloud-AI Guardrails

  • Define secure design patterns for AI-enabled applications, including LLM-based features, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents, AI APIs, copilots, and automation workflows.

  • Establish cloud security requirements for AI workloads, including identity, secrets, data storage, network access, observability, workload isolation, and third-party AI service integrations in partnership with Sec Architecture & AppSec.

  • Support AI application threat modelling and risk reviews in partnership with BISO/AppSec.

  • Create developer-facing guidance for safe use of AI coding assistants, AI APIs, data ingestion, vector stores, model outputs, and AI-generated code in partnership with BISO/AppSec.

Security Enablement and Workload Reduction

  • Convert recurring BISO/AppSec and Security Architecture questions into reusable guidance, decision trees, approved patterns, checklists, and self-service workflows.

  • Build lightweight intake and routing mechanisms that help determine when a request needs BISO review, AppSec review, architecture review, GRC input, or engineering remediation.

  • Create and maintain a library of approved cloud and AI security patterns that product and engineering teams can reuse.

  • Help reduce one-off security consultations by embedding approved security decisions into tooling, templates, and standard delivery workflows.

Requirements:

Essential -

  • Experience in machine learning engineering. Strong experience in cloud security engineering, application security, security architecture, DevSecOps, or security automation.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform such as AWS or Azure.

  • Practical knowledge of IAM, logging, encryption, secrets management, network security, storage security, vulnerability management, and secure CI/CD.

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and cloud security tooling such as CSPM, CNAPP, IaC scanning, SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, or policy-as-code.

  • Ability to translate security standards and architecture requirements into practical implementation patterns.

  • Familiarity with generative AI, LLM-enabled applications, AI-assisted development, or AI security risks.

  • Strong scripting, automation, workflow design, or tooling integration experience.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clear security guidance for engineering teams.

Desirable-

  • Experience building cloud security guardrails, landing zone controls, reusable modules, or automated remediation workflows.

  • Experience supporting regulated environments or environments with strict customer, contractual, or compliance obligations.

  • Familiarity with AI security frameworks and guidance such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, NIST Generative AI Profile, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, or Cloud Security Alliance AI security guidance.

  • Experience with RAG architecture, AI agents, vector databases, AI APIs, prompt engineering, or AI application threat modelling.

  • Experience building security knowledge assistants, prompt libraries, AI-assisted review workflows, or security automation.

Why Join Us?

Join our team and contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. If you are ready to advance your career and make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Work in a way that works for you

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

Working for you

We know that your well-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:

Required Skills & Experience:

  • Strong proficiency in Python for data processing and automation.
  • Experience with Informatica or similar ETL tools.

Nice to Have:

title: Outpatient Competency Restoration Program (OCRP) Therapist
description:
Join a team that shares your calling

At MultiCare, you’re more than just a job title — you’re part of a team built on trust that cares for each other, our patients and our communities. Belonging here means living our mission and values every day. If your purpose and passions align with ours, you’ll find a place to grow, do meaningful work and build a career you love in a community that feels like home.

FTE: 1.0 (full-time), Shift: 8:00AM - 4:30PM, Schedule: Monday - Friday

Position Summary

The Mental Health Therapist is a vital role at MultiCare, responsible for the delivery of clinical counseling and case management services. From patient advocacy to therapeutic interventions, this position will offer you dynamic engagements in your daily work functions.

Responsibilities:

  • You will provide person-centered counseling, advocacy and case management for patients
  • You will develop treatment plans which clearly identify the patient’s voice, treatment strategies, and specific outcome measures
  • You will meet agency documentation standards
  • You will meet authorization requirements of contracts
  • You will strategically tailor effective clinical/case management services to meet diverse patient needs

Requirements:

  • Washington State Counselor Agency Affiliated Registered (ACCR) credential must be applied for within thirty (30) days of hire. Employees may work while the application is pending for up to one hundred twenty (120) days, unless a higher credential is already held: Counselor Agency Affiliated Certified, Counselor Agency Affiliated Licensed, Mental Health Counselor Assoc (LMHCA), Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC), Marriage & Family Therap Assoc (LMFTA), Licensed Marriage & Family Therapist (LMFT), SW Associate Advanced License (LSWAA), SW Advanced Lic (LASW), SW Assoc Independent Clinical Lic (LSWAIC), SW Independent Clinical Lic (LICSW)
  • Previous experience providing mental health counseling services preferred
  • Driving is an essential function of this position. The incumbent will routinely travel between clinic, community, patient, and business locations in the performance of assigned duties and may be required to operate a personal vehicle and/or agency-owned vehicle. A valid driver's license, current automobile insurance, and acceptable driving record in compliance with agency vehicle-use requirements are required

​

About Greater Lakes Mental Health

Greater Lakes Mental Health is part of MultiCare’s Behavioral Health Network, serving more than 10,000 individuals across Pierce County each year. Providing mental health and substance use disorder treatment for adults, children and families with Medicaid coverage, Greater Lakes operates six convenient locations, including a 16-bed inpatient facility for voluntary and involuntary care. With experienced teams and robust training, caregivers help deliver recovery-oriented, trauma-informed care.

Why MultiCare?

Living our values

Respect, integrity, kindness and collaboration guide how we care for patients, communities and each other.

Belonging for all

Resource Groups and outreach programs help ensure every team member feels safe, seen, heard and valued.

Pacific Northwest lifestyle

Work and live where natural beauty, adventure and strong community connections are part of everyday life.

Pay and Benefit Expectations

We provide a comprehensive benefits package, including competitive salary, medical, dental and retirement benefits and paid time off. As required by various pay transparency laws, we share a competitive range of compensation for candidates hired into each position. The pay scale is $30.40 - $43.75 USD. However, pay is influenced by factors specific to applicants, including but not limited to: skill set, level of experience, and certification(s) and/or education. title: Associate Data Engineer
description:
The Opportunity

This is a full-time opportunity supporting Dentalcorp's ongoing data and analytics transformation. Dentalcorp operates a Dental Support Organization (DSO) model across 500+ clinics, centralizing technology, data, and operations while preserving clinical autonomy at the practice level. As Dentalcorp continues to modernize its technology landscape, the Data Engineering & Architecture team plays a critical role in delivering trusted data, scalable platforms, and actionable insights that enable better business decisions and improved patient outcomes. The Associate Data Engineer will contribute to the development, support, and continuous improvement of Dentalcorp's enterprise data platform. In this role, you will work alongside experienced data engineers, architects, analysts, and quality engineering team members to build foundational skills in data pipelines, data modelling, data quality, source system integration, and cloud data platforms. This is an ideal opportunity for someone early in their data engineering career who is eager to learn, enjoys solving technical problems, and wants to grow within a team that is building modern, enterprise-scale data capabilities.

Who You Are

You are a motivated and curious technology professional with a strong interest in data engineering, analytics, and cloud data platforms. You enjoy working with data, learning new tools, and understanding how reliable data solutions support business decisions. You are comfortable asking questions, receiving feedback, and applying what you learn to improve your work. You are detail-oriented, collaborative, and committed to building strong technical foundations. You understand that high-quality data engineering requires accuracy, documentation, testing, and disciplined delivery. You are energized by the opportunity to grow in a modern data environment where legacy systems, cloud platforms, reporting needs, and business transformation intersect. You are looking for a role where you can contribute meaningfully while continuing to develop your technical skills under the guidance of experienced team members. Our most successful team members are proactive, adaptable, and solution-oriented. They take ownership, embrace change, collaborate openly, and are driven by delivering exceptional results and service.

In This Role, You Will

Data Pipeline Development & Support

  • Assist with the development, maintenance, and support of data pipelines that enable reporting, analytics, and operational decision-making.
  • Support data ingestion, transformation, and validation activities across internal and external source systems.
  • Work with senior team members to troubleshoot data issues, investigate pipeline failures, and document resolution steps.
  • Contribute to the improvement of repeatable data engineering patterns, templates, and operational runbooks.

Snowflake & Cloud Data Platform Exposure

  • Build hands‑on experience with Dentalcorp's modern data platform, including Snowflake and related data engineering tools.
  • Support the migration, validation, and modernization of data assets as part of broader platform transformation initiatives.
  • Learn how cloud‑based data solutions are designed, deployed, monitored, and maintained in an enterprise environment.
  • Assist with performance investigation, data load validation, and environment support activities under guidance.

Data Quality & Validation

  • Support data validation, reconciliation, and quality assurance activities to help improve trust in enterprise data.
  • Work with QA, analytics, and business stakeholders to investigate data discrepancies and confirm expected outcomes.
  • Help document source‑to‑target mappings, validation results, known issues, and business rules.
  • Contribute to the development of checks and controls that improve data reliability over time.

Documentation, Collaboration & Delivery

  • Create and maintain clear technical documentation, including pipeline notes, data flow summaries, validation evidence, and operational procedures.
  • Participate in team ceremonies, planning sessions, design discussions, and delivery reviews.
  • Collaborate with data engineers, architects, QA team members, analysts, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver assigned work.
  • Use team tools such as Jira, Confluence, Git‑based source control, and CI/CD processes to support disciplined delivery.

Learning, Growth & Engineering Discipline

  • Develop foundational skills in SQL, data modelling, ETL/ELT development, orchestration, data warehousing, and source system integration.
  • Learn and follow team standards for development, testing, code review, deployment, and production support.
  • Seek feedback from senior engineers and apply it to improve technical quality and delivery consistency.
  • Build awareness of responsible AI‑assisted work, including the need to validate AI‑generated outputs and protect sensitive data.

What You’ll Bring

  • 1+ years of experience, internship experience, academic project work, or equivalent practical exposure in data engineering, analytics engineering, database development, software development, or a related technical discipline.
  • Foundational SQL skills, with an interest in query development, troubleshooting, and data validation.
  • Exposure to data pipelines, ETL/ELT concepts, data warehousing, or analytical reporting environments.
  • Interest in learning Snowflake or comparable cloud data platforms.
  • Familiarity with Python, scripting, or modern development practices is considered an asset.
  • Familiarity with source control, Jira, Confluence, CI/CD, or Agile delivery practices is considered an asset.
  • Strong attention to detail and a willingness to document work clearly and consistently.
  • Strong problem‑solving mindset, with the ability to investigate issues, ask thoughtful questions, and learn from feedback.
  • Effective communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across technical and non‑technical teams.
  • Interest in healthcare, multi‑site operations, or enterprise‑scale analytics is considered an asset.

About Dentalcorp

Dentalcorp is Canada’s largest and fastest growing network of dental practices, committed to advancing the overall well‑being of Canadians by delivering the best clinical outcomes and unforgettable experiences. Dentalcorp acquires leading dental practices, uniting its network in a common goal: to be Canada’s most trusted healthcare network. Leveraging its industry‑leading technology, know‑how and scale, Dentalcorp offers professionals the unique opportunity to retain their clinical autonomy while unlocking their potential for future growth.

The salary range for this position is $70,000 CAD to $90,000 CAD annually (plus a bonus of up to 10% and competitive total rewards and benefits package). Offers within this range are determined based on relevant experience, skills, and qualifications, as well as internal equity considerations. This role is 4 days on‑site Monday to Thursday with Friday's work from home. This job posting is for an existing vacancy. Candidates must be legally eligible to work in Canada. At Dentalcorp, we recognize that inclusivity and diversity strengthen our culture and make us better. We are committed to ensuring that the talent we hire is reflective of the diverse communities and patients we serve. To ensure equal opportunity for all candidates, we strongly encourage applicants requiring an accommodation to let their recruiter know during the recruitment/selection process. We appreciate all applicants for taking the time to apply, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted. Our purpose is to provide the best care for our patients. We empower our people and our practices with resources and technology to deliver exceptional care and patient outcomes. We are the future of dentistry: a network‑driven, entrepreneurial approach with the knowledge, scale and cutting‑edge technology to transform healthcare in Canada.

title: Data Engineer and Report Developer
description:
About the Company

Davidson Technology are working with a large State Government Department to secure a Data Engineer and Report Developer to enhance, maintain and optimise complex enterprise Data Warehouse environments across the Department.

About the Role

As the Data Engineer and Report Developer, you will be responsible for enhancing, maintaining and optimising complex enterprise Data Warehouse environments while delivering high-quality Power BI reporting solutions aligned with business requirements. You will analyse, define and document data and reporting requirements, design and develop robust ETL processes across SQL Server and Microsoft Fabric, and proactively investigate and improve data pipeline and report performance. You will design and implement scalable semantic models and operational data stores that support reliable analytics and informed decision-making, while developing intuitive and effective Power BI reports and dashboards. You will also establish and maintain Microsoft DevOps CI/CD deployment pipelines to enable controlled, automated and repeatable solution delivery. Drawing on your expertise in contemporary business intelligence, data engineering and reporting practices, you will provide specialist technical advice to stakeholders and contribute to the delivery of secure, maintainable and high-performing enterprise data and analytics solutions.

About You

As an experienced Data Engineer and Report Developer, you will bring advanced expertise in designing, developing and supporting enterprise Data Warehouse and Business Intelligence solutions using the Microsoft SQL Server suite, including SSAS, SSIS and SSRS, together with Microsoft Fabric and Power BI. You will have extensive experience developing ETL workflows, data mappings and scalable data warehouse solutions, supported by a strong understanding of conceptual, logical and physical data modelling and the ability to reverse-engineer existing data structures into BI-aligned data models. You will apply high-level report design and development skills and contemporary best practices to deliver accurate, intuitive and business-focused reporting solutions. Working closely with business SMEs and stakeholder groups, you will effectively gather, analyse and refine complex requirements, understand key business needs and drivers, and provide informed advice on appropriate data and reporting solutions. Your excellent written, verbal and visual communication skills, combined with well-developed interpersonal and relationship management capabilities, will enable you to translate technical concepts into clear business outcomes and deliver high-quality data and analytics solutions that meet organisational needs.

The Benefits

You will be offered a 12-month contract with possible extension on an excellent hourly rate and the ability to negotiate a flexible working arrangement for the duration of the assignment.

title: Senior Performance Test Engineer

In this role, you will design, implement and execute performance testing and synthetic monitoring solutions, ensuring system scalability, stability and reliability for business-critical applications. You will work closely with development teams and stakeholders to identify performance bottlenecks, optimize application responsiveness and deliver actionable insights that drive continuous improvement across technology platforms.

  • Implement and maintain synthetic monitoring solutions to evaluate system availability and user experience
  • Analyze performance test results and produce clear reports with optimization recommendations
  • Review performance and monitoring code in Java, JavaScript or TypeScript for compliance with standards
  • Act as a trusted advisor in defining performance testing strategies and monitoring best practices

  • Proficiency in Playwright (Java, TypeScript) and Grafana k6 (JavaScript) for performance automation
  • Experience integrating tests with CI/CD pipelines using GitLab, Jenkins or Bitbucket
  • Strong understanding of performance engineering principles, APIs, cloud-native applications and networking
  • Proven ability to communicate technical results and translate them into business-relevant insights
  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability platforms such as Grafana, Prometheus, Dynatrace
  • Knowledge of performance metrics, OpenTelemetry concepts, distributed tracing and E2E analysis
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder collaboration and problem-solving skills

Konekuskina vastaat pyöräkuormaajalla tehtävistä talvikunnossapidon töistä läpi talvikauden, kuten lumenaurauksista, lumensiirroista, hiekoituksista sekä keväällä hiekoituksien poistosta. Työalueeseesi kuuluu erilaiset liike-, tuotanto- ja asuinkiinteistöt Jyväskylän alueella.

Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on kokemusta koneenkuljettajan tehtävistä ja joka työskentelee huolellisesti, turvallisesti ja itsenäisesti. Etsimme erityisesti kokemusta vastaavista koneellisista talvikunnossapidon töistä ja pyöräkuormaajien käytöstä. Työ edellyttää vastuullista otetta, sillä konekuskina huolehdit siitä, että työt tehdään laadukkaasti ja liikenneturvallisuus säilyy hyvänä kaikissa olosuhteissa. Eduksi katsotaan, jos sinulta löytyy C-ajokortti.

Työsuhde on määräaikainen loka-marraskuun vaihteesta huhtikuuhun 2027. Mikäli sinulla on kiinnostusta työskennellä erilaisissa kiinteistönhoidon tehtävissä ja viherrakentamisen projekteissa, on talvikauden jälkeen mahdollisuus pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen. Edellytämme joustavuutta työaikojen suhteen, sillä työskentelet silloin, kun keli sen vaatii. Lumilähdöt painottuvat varhaisiin aamuihin.

Mikäli kiinnostuit, hae paikkaa pian ja varmista työpaikkasi talvikaudelle!

title: QA Lead, DomaCare
description:
DomaCare on yksi nopeimmin kasvavista sosiaali- ja hoiva-alan ohjelmistoratkaisuista, jota tuhannet hoiva-alan ammattilaiset käyttävät päivittäin ympäri Suomen. Oululaisen Invian Oy:n kehittämä DomaCare lanseerattiin vuonna 2005, ja se on siitä lähtien vakiinnuttanut vahvan asemansa suomalaisella sote-alalla.

Etsimme näkemyksellistä ja "kädet savessa" viihtyvää QA Leadiä johtamaan ja rakentamaan tulevaisuuden laadunvarmistusta!

Haluatko olla etulinjassa viemässä ohjelmistojen testausta uudelle aikakaudelle? Etsimme kokenutta QA-ammattilaista, joka ymmärtää laadunvarmistuksen kokonaiskuvan ideasta tuotantoon ja on valmis valjastamaan tekoälyn (erityisesti Clauden AI-agentit) osaksi jatkuvan testauksen ydintä.

Tässä roolissa et vain hallinnoi prosesseja, vaan suunnittelet, rakennat ja ajat niitä käytännössä. Olet laadunvarmistuksemme arkkitehti ja toteuttaja samassa paketissa.

Mitä tulet tekemään?

  • Jatkuvan testauksen suunnittelu ja pyörittäminen: Vastaat end-to-end -testausprosessin (ideasta tuotantoon) suunnittelusta, pystyttämisestä ja päivittäisestä operoinnista.

  • AI-agenttien orkestrointi: Roolisi ydin on suunnitella, kuinka Clauden tekoälyagentit toimivat testauksen eri vaiheissa. Määrittelet agenttien roolit (esim. vaatimusten analysointi, testitapausten generointi, koodin katselmointi, automaatioajot) ja vastaat niiden käytännön toiminnasta.

  • Hands-on -tekeminen: Vaikka rakennamme pitkälle vietyä AI-automaatiota, uskomme ihmisen asiantuntijuuteen. Olet valmis hyppäämään puikkoihin ja tekemään manuaalista tai tutkivaa testausta aina silloin, kun tilanne vaatii syvällistä inhimillistä päättelyä.

  • Laatukulttuurin johtaminen (ilman esihenkilövastuuta): Toimit linkkinä tuotehallinnan, kehittäjien ja AI-työkalujen välillä varmistaen, että laatu on sisäänrakennettu jokaiseen työvaiheeseen. Toimit vahvassa asiantuntijaveturin roolissa.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

  • Vahvaa teknistä taustaa ja ohjelmointiosaamista: Ymmärrät ohjelmistoarkkitehtuuria ja kykenet lukemaan sekä hahmottamaan koodia (esim. Java). Taustasi voi olla ohjelmistokehityksessä tai vahvasti kooditason testausautomaation parissa. Tämä on välttämätöntä, jotta pystyt ohjaamaan AI-agentteja teknisissä tehtävissä, kuten koodin katselmoinneissa, ja analysoimaan virhetilanteita syvällisesti.

  • Vankkaa QA-taustaa: Sinulla on vahva kokemus ohjelmistotestauksesta, testausautomaatiosta ja mielellään kokemusta QA Lead tai Senior QA -roolista.

  • Modernien prosessien ymmärrystä: Jatkuva testaus (Continuous Testing), CI/CD-putket ja ketterät menetelmät ovat sinulle arkipäivää.

  • AI-orientoitunutta mindsettiä: Sinulla ei tarvitse olla koneoppimisen tohtorin tutkintoa, mutta ymmärrät LLM-mallien (erityisesti Anthropic Claude) kyvykkyydet ja rajoitteet. Osaat promptata, iteroida ja suunnitella työnkulkuja, joissa AI tekee raskaan työn puolestasi.

  • Pragmaattista "Can do" -asennetta: Et pelkää liata käsiäsi. Kun automaatio kaatuu tai edge case yllättää, osaat avata kehittäjätyökalut, lukea logeja ja testata ominaisuuden manuaalisesti.

  • Systeemistä ajattelua: Pystyt pilkkomaan monimutkaisen ohjelmistokehitysprosessin osiin ja tunnistamaan, missä vaiheessa AI-agentti tuottaa eniten lisäarvoa.

  • Sujuvaa kielitaitoa: Päivittäiset työkielemme ovat suomi ja englanti. Edellytämme sinulta sujuvaa suullista ja kirjallista ilmaisutaitoa molemmilla kielillä, jotta kommunikaatio tiimin kanssa on saumatonta.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Tässä roolissa pääset luomaan ratkaisuja, joilla on todellista merkitystä arjen hoivatyössä, auttaen hoitajia viettämään enemmän aikaa asiakkaidensa kanssa. Emme vain osta valmista "AI-testaustyökalua", vaan rakennamme räätälöityjä ja älykkäitä työnkulkuja. Tässä roolissa pääset aidosti kokeilemaan, oppimaan ja viemään alan parhaita käytäntöjä eteenpäin.

Tarjoamme työpaikan, josta löydät mahtavan tiimin sekä välittömän, lämminhenkisen ja kunnianhimoisen kulttuurin. Tiimissämme jokaisen panos on tärkeä. Arvostamme kaikkien mielipiteitä ja näkökulmia, ja kannustamme ottamaan omistajuutta kehitystehtävistä. Asetamme haastavia tavoitteita ja annamme sinulle paljon vastuuta, mutta olemme myös tukenasi koko matkan ajan. Vaikka vastuut on selkeästi määritelty, teemme tiivistä yhteistyötä ja viemme tuotetta eteenpäin yhtenä joukkueena. Haluamme sinun loistavan!

Työympäristömme on ystävällinen ja rento, hierarkia on matala ja ilmapiiri avoin. Tuemme jatkuvaa oppimista ja itsensä kehittämistä, ja sinulla on vapaus valita joustavasti työaikasi sekä se, työskenteletkö toimistolla, etänä vai hybridimallilla. Toimistomme sijaitsevat Helsingissä ja Oulussa. Toivomme sinun kuitenkin pääsevän toisinaan matkustamaan tiimi-, tuotekehitys- tai yritystapaamisiin.

Maksamme kilpailukykyistä palkkaa, ja lisäksi saat käyttöösi hyvät edut: lounas- ja hyvinvointiedun, puhelinedun sekä työterveyden lisäksi työkykyvakuutuksen.

Hae nyt – kerromme mielellämme lisää!

Palkkaus tässä roolissa asettuu kokemuksesi ja osaamisesi perusteella 4 500 – 5500 euron välille kuukaudessa. Kuulemme kuitenkin mielellämme myös oman palkkatoiveesi.

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja palkkatoiveesi mahdollisimman pian, kuitenkin viimeistään 6.9.2026.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Kimmo Laakkonen sähköpostitse () tai puhelimitse (040 545 6876) arkisin klo 8.30–9.00.

Arvostamme monimuotoisuutta ja olemme sitoutuneet luomaan yhdenvertaisen työympäristön kaikille työntekijöillemme. Huomioimme mielellämme yksilölliset tarpeet myös rekrytointiprosessin aikana. Ilmoitathan hakemuksessasi, mikäli tarvitset erityistä tukea tai järjestelyitä.

Oululaisen Invian Oy:n kehittämä DomaCare-toiminnanohjausjärjestelmä sai alkunsa vuonna 2005, jonka jälkeen se on saavuttanut vahvan aseman osana suomalaista sosiaali- ja hoitoalaa. Taustallamme on ketterä pohjoismainen ohjelmistotalo Visma, joka työllistää Suomessa jo 1500 asiantuntijaa.
