WHO WE ARE

Founded in 2013 as Scape Australia, leaders in student housing, we've since grown into a vertically integrated living platform known as The Living Company; managing $17B in assets across Student Living (Scape), Rent to Live – Affordable Housing (RTL Co.), and Retirement Living (Aveo); spanning site origination, investment, planning, design, development, construction, and operations.

The Living Company is reshaping the way Australians live by delivering sustainable, community-driven, and high-quality spaces across the country.

THE ROLE

Ready to build the data foundation that powers decisions for 10,000+ retirement living residents across Australia? As our new Analytics Engineer, you'll be at the centre of a greenfield Snowflake deployment, designing and building the pipelines, models and data products the whole business will run on.

This isn't a maintenance role. You'll shape how data flows from source systems through to Finance, Sales, Marketing and Operations reporting, working directly with stakeholders to understand what they need and translating that into clean, reliable, well-documented dbt models.

Day-to-day you will be (but not limited to):

  • Contributing to the Snowflake data platform deployment, building out infrastructure from the ground up
  • Migrating legacy data infrastructure into Snowflake across multiple business domains
  • Building and maintaining dbt models across bronze, silver, gold and platinum layers, writing clean, tested and well-documented SQL
  • Building and maintaining data ingestion into Snowflake via Fivetran and Snowpark-based pipelines
  • Turning raw source data into trusted, analytics-ready data products the business can rely on
  • Working directly with Finance, CRM and operational teams to gather and refine data requirements
  • Translating business problems and ambiguous requirements into clear, scalable data solutions
  • Monitoring and maintaining data pipeline health, troubleshooting issues and ensuring reliability
  • Contributing to emerging AI data initiatives as the platform matures
  • Staying close to evolving best practice in the modern data stack (Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran) and bringing new ideas back to the team

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • 3–5 years in an Analytics Engineering or similar data engineering role
  • Background in consulting, professional services, startup or scaleup environments, comfortable moving fast across multiple business domains
  • Strong SQL and dbt experience, having built and maintained production data models
  • Hands‑on experience with Snowflake
  • Experience with Fivetran or similar ingestion tooling
  • Python proficiency, comfortable building scripts and pipelines including Snowpark-based workloads
  • Comfortable with CI/CD fundamentals, including version control, pull request workflows and automated deployment
  • Familiarity with data pipeline monitoring and troubleshooting
  • Self‑directed, able to take a brief and drive it to completion without handholding
  • Experience with data visualisation tools (Power BI, Tableau or similar), exposure to AI/ML data initiatives, or experience in property, retirement living or similar complex operational environments will be highly regarded

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN?

  • Be part of a purpose‑led organisation shaping how Australians live
  • Exposure to a large, diversified living platform with real scale and complexity
  • Strong focus on well‑being, growth, and inclusive culture
  • Competitive rewards, recognition programs, and lifestyle benefits

Our workplace embraces diversity and strives to create an inclusive environment that respects and values your culture, traditions, and perspectives. Join us in building a harmonious and empowered community where everyone's voice is heard and celebrated.

title: Project Geostructural Engineer
description:
GeoEngineers is seeking a Project engineer to join our Construction Design Discipline in Seattle, WA, Redmond, WA, or Tacoma, WA. As part of our team, you will deliver engineering solutions for temporary works and design-build projects including excavation support systems, cofferdams, access trestles, working platforms, construction staging, falsework, and deep foundations. You will work directly with contractors, other geotechnical teams, and design-build partners to produce practical, constructable, and efficient designs on some of the most technically demanding projects in the region.


Your work will include structural and geotechnical engineering, building a career at the intersection of design and construction. You will contribute to a diverse project portfolio, develop technical depth under the mentorship of experienced engineers, and grow your project management responsibility while having meaningful ownership of your work.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the design of geo-structural solutions, including excavation support systems, ground improvement, retaining walls, work staging plans, access trestles, driven piles, micropiles, and other deep foundations.
  • Complete and manage engineering analyses relevant to structural and geotechnical engineering within your area of focus such as steel design (AISC/LRFD), timber design, deep foundation design, slope stability modeling, and ground improvement design (DSM, rigid inclusions, stone columns, DDC), under the supervision of a project principal or associate.
  • Development project drawings using AutoCAD, Civil 3D, and Revit.
  • Apply strong problem-solving and spatial reasoning to complex site challenges to ensure constructable, efficient deliverables.
  • Partner with project teams and clients to coordinate design and resolve technical issues.
  • Develop project deliverables such as memos, calculation packages, and reports, and complete in-depth reviews of deliverables prepared by others.
  • Support project management tasks including budget planning, field report reviews, project implementation plans, proposal development, contractor submittals, RFIs, and participate in client meetings. Manages small projects under the supervision of a certified professional engineer as required.
  • Lead or coordinate the observation of field explorations and construction activities, ensuring that work is consistent with project plans, specifications, and safety guidelines.
  • Assist in business development and marketing activities to grow our practice.
  • Self-motivated, with the ability to manage day-to-day tasks and commitments to other team members is essential.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering from an accredited college or university; Master's degree in Geotechnical or Structural Engineering preferred.
  • 3+ years of related professional experience
  • PE license required
  • Flexibility in handling diverse project requirements and the ability to work effectively across both geotechnical and structural engineering domains
  • Experience with software commonly used in geotechnical and structural design, such as MathCAD, RISA, Tedds, Civil 3D, Plaxis, CLiq, CPeT-IT, SHAFT, APile, or the GeoStudio Suite. Familiarity with specialized analysis tools such as SNAIL, DeepEX, Slope/W, L-Pile, Group, and MSEW+ is preferreds.
  • Experience with driven pile, drilled shaft or small-diameter pile/anchor testing
  • Valid driver's license


Physical Requirements

  • All candidates are subject to completing background and reference checks.
  • All candidates are required to participate in our medical surveillance program.
  • Ability to perform a wide range of physical activities and do heavy work including exerting up to 50 pounds of force on occasion.
  • Ability to perform consistent work on a PC with prolonged sitting and view of a monitor/screen.
  • Ability to travel for short-term and long-term assignments as needed. Travel will typically not exceed 20%.
  • All employees are responsible for conducting their work in a safe manner. This includes identifying potential safety hazards and reporting them to the designated project manager in a timely manner and participating in project safety briefings. This also includes wearing appropriate safety equipment when working in the field and completing all required health & safety training prior to beginning fieldwork.


Our best estimate of the salary range for this position, located in Seattle, WA, and Redmond, WA, is $92,000 - $130,000 annually. Our best estimate of the salary range for this position, located in Tacoma, WA, is $89,000 - $126,000 annually. Compensation offered will be based on a variety of individual factors, including education and experience, as well as internal equity. GeoEngineers’ salary ranges are reviewed and updated each year and employees are eligible for pay increases based on individual performance. As part of our competitive total rewards package, employees in this role may also be eligible for our annual year-end bonus offering, subject to program eligibility requirements.


At GeoEngineers, investing in our people is a top priority. In addition to competitive and equitable pay, we are proud to offer a wide range of benefits to support employees and their families, including healthcare (with travel benefit for care not locally available), 401(k) with company match, short-term and long-term disability, life insurance, wellbeing benefits, paid vacation and sick time and paid holidays, among others. title: Foster Coordinator
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

This position is responsible for providing exceptional customer service and care for our community. Areas of responsibility include, but not limited to recruiting, developing and maintaining a dynamic foster client base while managing the movement of animals from shelter to foster care to adoption. Promotes teamwork and maintains an optimistic attitude all while assisting in intake, surrender of animals, lost and found, return to owner, and adoptions. This diverse role also includes educating the public regarding humane pet ownership, humane law and regulations, and the overall services and resources offered by the Louisiana SPCA.


ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBLITIES


Foster Program Coordination

  • Be a consistent and visible presence with foster care providers; be available to answer questions, receive feedback, lend a hand, and ensure deep understanding of and compliance with the LASPCA foster program procedures and operations.
  • Provide all foster families with direct, transparent communication about the purpose of their foster assignment and help those fostering animals with medical and/or behavioral risks to understand that humane euthanasia may ultimately be the appropriate outcome for that animal.
  • Ensure that all foster volunteers receive any necessary supplies for an animal in their care and that volunteers are well informed about the animal they will be fostering.
  • Support foster population while providing training, supervision, modeling, coaching and ongoing guidance to foster families.
  • Provide top customer service to LASPCA’s foster families, respond to emails, text messages, Facebook posts and phone calls from foster parents in a timely manner and resolve issues as they arise.
  • Provide all foster volunteers with comprehensive ongoing training in disease control and prevention in their home, animal handling and safety techniques.
  • Schedule and facilitate foster drop-offs and organize transportation for offsite placement, transfers and consults.
  • Promote, communicate and encourage all foster families to attend upcoming offsite adoption events/opportunities with their foster animal.

Logistics and Data

  • Monitor daily the animal populations in foster care, with attention to volume, capacity for care, length of stay (LOS) and animal flow out of foster care and into adoption placement.
  • In conjunction with the Pathway team, the Foster Coordinator identifies opportunities for positive outcomes, seek ways to increase capacity and annual foster placements, while being mindful of annual goals, capacity for care and LOS
  • Maintain a “foster on deck” process to ensure timely and efficient flow of animals into foster care.
  • Utilize innovative tools to contribute to foster recruitment, promote foster retention and streamline foster assignments.
  • Continuously seek out, learn and implement best practices in the field related to foster care, animal relocation and animal placement.
  • Maintain and update daily a foster tracking database that captures with precise detail intake, outcome, behavioral and medical data for each foster.

Collaboration (Externally and Internally)

  • Check in with foster families regularly and update staff and /volunteers with any important information.
  • Partner closely with the Foster Vet Tech and Shelter Clinic team to manage daily incoming and outgoing animal population from the facility to foster care.
  • Collaborate with the Adoptions and medical team to select animals from the shelter/rescue into off-site adoption spaces (e.g. pet supply stores) or into foster care.
  • Cultivate positive and productive relationships with staff to promote positive outcomes, both through diversion and transfers.
  • Ensure a respectful and welcoming environment, practice open and respectful communication, provide constructive feedback.
  • Maintain positive and productive relationships with external partners that provide services to the foster population.
  • Nurture a culture of growth and learning and actively participate in meeting mutual goals to increase the live release rate of feline shelter populations.

title: AV Technicians | Senior  Junior Opportunities
description:
AV Technicians Wanted | Senior + Junior Opportunities

Join TEK Co. Build cool tech. See more than the workshop walls.

TEK Co is growing, and we're looking for good people to grow with us.
We design, install and support audiovisual and technology solutions across South Australia, with a strong presence in education through TeachTEK, alongside commercial, government and specialist technology projects.
Our work isn't about installing the same thing in the same place every day.
One week you might be fitting out classrooms and interactive displays, the next commissioning a school hall, Teams Room, PA system, LED display or heading regional to deliver a complete technology upgrade.

We're currently looking for:

Senior Technical Lead | Full-Time

We're looking for an experienced technology technician who can confidently take ownership of installations, solve problems on site and deliver work to a high standard.

You'll be working across projects including:

  • Commercial AV installations

  • Interactive displays and large-format screens

  • Projection systems

  • Video conferencing and Microsoft Teams Rooms

  • PA, audio and microphone systems

  • Digital signage and LED

  • Wireless presentation systems

  • Equipment racks and structured AV infrastructure

  • Basic network-connected AV systems

  • System commissioning, testing and fault finding

  • Site surveys, upgrades and technology refresh projects

We're looking for someone who can do more than simply follow an install sheet.

You'll need to be comfortable thinking on your feet, communicating with clients, working independently when required and helping lead junior technicians on larger projects.

Experience within commercial AV, electrical, communications, integration or a similar technical field will be highly regarded.

Junior Technical Assistant | Part-Time with Potential Full-Time Opportunity

Maybe you've worked in AV before. Maybe you're an installer, cabler, tradie, IT person or just seriously good with tools and technology.

We're open to finding the right person with the right attitude and teaching them the rest.

This role will involve working alongside our technicians to:

  • Install displays, brackets and AV equipment

  • Assist with equipment racks and cabling

  • Set up and configure technology

  • Complete basic testing and commissioning

  • Prepare equipment before deployment

  • Assist with site installations and project rollouts

  • Learn commercial audiovisual systems from an experienced team

The junior position can initially be part-time, with the potential to develop into a full-time role for the right person.

We're less interested in whether you know every AV acronym on day one and more interested in whether you're practical, reliable, switched on and willing to learn.

Travel is part of the job

This bit is important. Travel is an essential requirement of both positions.

TEK Co delivers projects across metropolitan Adelaide, regional South Australia and occasionally further afield.

That means these aren't roles where you'll always clock on and off at the same location.

There will be:

  • Regional project work

  • Early starts from time to time

  • Overnight stays

  • Multi-day regional installations

  • Travel as part of project delivery

For the right person, it's also one of the best parts of the job. You get out, see different parts of the state, work on some fantastic sites and actually see the projects you've helped build come to life.

The person we're looking for

Across both roles, we value people who:

  • Take pride in their workmanship

  • Can work as part of a team

  • Are comfortable dealing with customers and school staff

  • Turn up when they say they will

  • Look after tools, equipment and vehicles

  • Can problem-solve rather than immediately throwing their hands in the air

  • Are willing to learn new systems and technologies

  • Understand that clean, tidy installation work matters

  • Can work safely and professionally on active sites

  • Are comfortable travelling for work

A current driver's licence and valid Working With Children Check (WWCC) are essential requirements for both roles. Relevant AV, communications, cabling, electrical, IT or construction experience is advantageous depending on the position.

Why TEK Co?

We're not a giant corporate integrator where you're technician number 247.
We're a growing South Australian technology business with a hands-on team and a genuine appetite for doing interesting work. You'll get exposure to a broad range of technology, brands and project types, with opportunities to develop your skills rather than being stuck doing one repetitive task.

We work hard, we back our team, and we like finding smarter ways to get things done.

If this sounds like your kind of workplace, we'd like to hear from you.

Send us your resume along with a short introduction telling us a bit about yourself, what you've worked on and why you think you'd be a good fit for TEK Co.

Come build some seriously good tech with us.

TeachTEK | IoT-TEK | RealityTEK

title: DRR Field Facilitator
description:
With 75 years of experience, our focus is on helping the most vulnerable children overcome poverty and experience fullness of life. We help children of all backgrounds, even in the most dangerous places, inspired by our Christian faith.

Come join our 31,000+ staff working in nearly 100 countries and share the joy of transforming vulnerable children’s life stories!

Employee Contract Type:

Local - Fixed Term Employee (Fixed Term)

Job Description:


Position Purpose:

The DRR Field Facilitator will support the day-to-day implementation of Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR) activities at the community/camp level, acting as the frontline link between the project team and affected households. The role focuses on facilitating awareness sessions, household visits, data collection, and mobilization support to ensure vulnerable households, especially children, are reached with timely information and services.


Key Objectives of the Position:


Field-Level Facilitation

  • Facilitate community awareness sessions on disaster preparedness, early warning signals, and response actions for landslides and flooding
  • Support the mobilization of households/community members for CERT training, drills, and other DRR activities
  • Assist in organizing and facilitating meetings with community groups, camp committees, and vulnerable household representatives

Household-Level Engagement

  • Conduct household-level visits to identify and collect information on affected children and their families
  • Identify vulnerable households (e.g., persons with disabilities, single-headed households, elderly, young children) for targeted support and readiness planning
  • Follow up with households on referrals, service access, and participation in DRR activities

Data Collection & Documentation

  • Collect field-level data and case information to support emergency needs assessments
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date records of household visits, attendance, and activity documentation
  • Provide field-level inputs and updates for Situation Reports (SitRep)

Support to Site Management & Coordination

  • Liaise with Site Management and Camp-in-Charge (CiC) at the field level for smooth delivery of activities and access to camp facilities/learning centers
  • Report any protection concerns, service gaps, or emerging risks (e.g., signs of landslide/flood risk) to supervisors promptly
  • Support other sectoral teams (health, education, WASH, etc.) with field-level coordination as needed

Community Feedback & Accountability

  • Facilitate two-way communication between the community and project team, including feedback and complaints referral
  • Ensure community members, including children and vulnerable groups, are informed about project activities and their rights to participat

Support to training facilitation, communications and Implementation:


  • Good interpersonal and communication skills; comfortable engaging with diverse community members
  • Basic data collection and documentation skills
  • Willingness to travel/work in field and camp conditions, including during emergencies
  • Fluency in local language; basic English an advantage
  • Respectful, patient, and empathetic approach when working with vulnerable households and children
  • Good report-writing and documentation skills
  • Ability to work under pressure in emergency contexts and travel to field/camp locations
  • Strong interpersonal and community engagement skills
  • Mainstream protection, accountability, gender, disability, and environmental protection
  • All documents guiding implementation, such as budgets, DIPs, and projections, are prepared, updated, and used correctly
  • Ensure needs assessments and surveys are conducted, data analyzed, and suggestions made for appropriate interventions as needed.
  • Regular monitoring and reporting of project implementation.

Staff Management:


  • Line manages the staff(s) of the assigned project(s), including day-to-day management, development and training etc.
  • Take responsibility for discussing job expectations; appraise performance against set objectives regularly.
  • Overall responsibility for staff work plans, vacation schedules, and development activities, and maintain a professional and open relationship with team members, promoting a strong spirit and providing oversight and guidance to allow for successful team performance.
  • Staff coaching and technical supervision for their development.

Coordination and networking:


  • Actively participate in camp sectoral meetings to ensure WV programming information is shared and requests for cluster mechanisms are responded to.
  • Keep and share information from NGO meetings, government correspondence, and internal World Vision Lessons Learned.
  • Ensure that World Vision is represented in coordination forums and review meetings.
  • Foster formal government at all levels and community engagement and coordination

Financial Management:


  • Manage the DRR assignment project and ensure all expenses are according to budget and meet donor standards for financial management, including accountability and good governance.
  • Manage the program budget through the passing of timely orders, the preparation of monthly forecasts, and the monitoring of expenditure.

Spiritual Leadership:

  • Exhibit spiritual maturity, integrity, and a dynamic personal sense of life calling

Knowledge, Skill & Experience:

Required Education, training, license, registration, and/or Certification:


  • Bachelor's degree in Social Science, Development Studies, or related field

  • Minimum 1–2 years of field-level experience in community work, humanitarian response, or DRR programming
  • Familiarity with camp settings, CiC/Site Management structures, and community mobilization approaches preferred
  • Local candidates or those familiar with the project area strongly preferred

  • Knowledge of DRR & Climate Change Adaptation Intervention, System Strengthening & Networking, Livelihood, Group Management, etc.
  • Reporting and accounting experience needed
  • Experience in project implementation, monitoring, evaluation, and report writing.
  • Good at communication, interpersonal skills, and cross-cultural sensitivity.
  • Familiar with the various tools used in the field for program monitoring
  • Excellent English communication skills (oral and written)
  • Knowledge of MS Office, websites, Outlook, and Lotus Notes
  • Commitment to World Vision Core Values and Mission Statement
  • Ability to exhibit exemplary lifestyle as interpreted in a specific local culture context
  • Agreement with World Vision’s ethos
  • Cross-cultural sensitivity, flexible world view, emotional maturity, and physical stamina

Required Language(s): English, Bangla and Rohingya

Must be willing and able to travel working are/in the country

Some project locations may be in remote areas. Staff are expected to live in the location for short periods

Committed to World Vision Ethos, Mission, Vision, and Core Values

As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

Job Description:

Leads the Data Products and Engineering function, accountable for creating reusable, trusted, business-ready data products that enable front office teams and other stakeholders to make better decisions, accelerate analytics and AI use cases, reduce duplicated data builds, and strengthen governance, lineage, quality, and controls.

Core accountabilities

  • Develop and execute the Data Products and Engineering strategy, roadmap, and operating model in alignment with the broader Data, Analytics and AI vision.
  • Design reusable, trusted business-ready data products with clear ownership, schemas, refresh cadence, quality expectations, and adoption paths.
  • Engineer modern data models and AI-ready data structures to support analytics, agentic workflows, and decision support.
  • Develop and govern semantic layers that define business metrics and dimensions consistently across consumption channels.
  • Create graph-based ontologies and business relationship models that make client, product, book, account, revenue, risk, and related concepts explicit and machine-readable where warranted.
  • Partner with Technology on production implementation, industrialization, platform patterns, controls, and sustainable support models.
  • Establish data quality, lineage, provenance, metadata management, observability, and source-correction expectations for products under the function.
  • Ensure data products consume approved reference and master data. Escalate missing shared hierarchies or attributes rather than allowing local forks to persist.
  • Build a product-led delivery model that separates rapid discovery and validation from scalable technology industrialization.
  • Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team spanning product ownership, data engineering, modelling, semantics, ontology, business analysis, and front office domain expertise.
  • Represent front office data product needs in cross-functional governance forums and enterprise data, AI, and technology working groups as required.

Decision authorities and scope:

  • Prioritize the Data Products and Engineering roadmap in partnership with business sponsors, Technology, and governance stakeholders.
  • Set standards for registered data products, including product specifications, data contracts, semantic definitions, quality measures, versioning, and change management.
  • Recommend architectural decisions for data assets based on consistency, domain expertise, reuse, control, and front office value.
  • Guide build versus reuse decisions to reduce duplicated engineering effort and long-term reconciliation costs.
  • Business sponsors and front office leaders for prioritization, prototyping, fit-for-purpose validation, adoption, and outcomes.
  • Technology partners for production engineering, platform implementation, resiliency, operational support, access controls, and industrialization.
  • Reference Data and Master Data teams for client hierarchies, product taxonomy, book and business line hierarchy, securities and instrument master, standard definitions, and reference models.
  • AI Products and Decision Sciences for Agentic AI, workflow orchestration, experimentation, prototyping, business validation, and AI-enabled product adoption.
  • Central data governance, ontology, semantics, risk, and compliance functions for standards, lineage, metadata, regulatory traceability, and risk-based oversight.
  • Adoption of registered, reusable data products by front office and partner teams.
  • Reduction in manual reconciliation, duplicated local builds, and one-off data extracts.
  • Data quality, availability, freshness, lineage completeness, and SLA performance against published data contracts.
  • Cycle time from opportunity discovery through prototype, business validation, product build, technology industrialization, and scale.
  • Measured business value from analytics, AI, and decisioning use cases enabled by the data product estate.
  • Team health, talent development, delivery predictability, and stakeholder satisfaction.

This role is not expected to be directly customer-facing. It drives customer and shareholder value by simplifying and strengthening the front office data foundation used for analytics, decisioning, AI-enabled workflows, risk insight, relationship coverage, revenue attribution, and operational efficiency.

  • Enhances the speed, consistency, and confidence of business decisions by making trusted data products easier to discover, understand, and reuse.
  • Creates authoritative business context that makes analytics and AI outputs more explainable, traceable, and governed.
  • Reduces friction across business, Technology, Risk, Finance, Compliance, and control functions by aligning common definitions and reusable product components.
  • Enables faster validation of new business opportunities while preserving the production controls required for scale.
  • Delivery of priority roadmap milestones
  • Reuse of semantic definitions, ontology fragments, product specifications, and engineered components across domains.

Skills, Education & Experience:

  • 15+ years of experience in capital markets, front office data, data product management, data engineering, analytics, AI, or technology delivery including experience at the senior leadership level.
  • Undergraduate degree required or equivalent practical experience. Advanced degree in data, computer science, engineering, mathematics, finance, business, or related field preferred.
  • Deep understanding of front office domains such as Sales and Trading, Corporate Banking, Investment Banking, and Payments, with ability to translate business problems into data and AI product capabilities.
  • Strong experience leading multidisciplinary teams, setting operating models, building roadmaps, managing priorities, and developing senior talent.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of modern data architecture, Lakehouse platforms, data modelling, data contracts, metadata, data quality, lineage, provenance, observability, and production engineering controls.
  • Working knowledge of semantic layers, metric governance, ontological thinking, knowledge graphs, and AI-ready data structures.
  • Experience partnering with Technology to industrialize prototypes into production-grade solutions with controls, resiliency, and support models.
  • Strong stakeholder management capability across business, Technology, Risk, Compliance, Finance, and enterprise governance groups.
  • Excellent executive communication skills, including ability to simplify complex technical and operating model decisions for senior audiences.

Who We Are:

TD Securities offers a wide range of capital markets products and services to corporate, government, and institutional clients who choose us for our innovation, execution, and experience. With more than 6,500 professionals operating out of 40 cities across the globe, we strive to make every interaction, product and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple. Our services include underwriting and distributing new issues, providing trusted advice and industry-leading insight, extending access to global markets, and delivering integrated transaction banking solutions. In 2023, we acquired Cowen Inc., offering our clients access to a premier U.S. equities business and highly-diverse equity research franchise, while growing our strong, diversified investment bank.

title: Mainframe Senior Architect – Performance & Capacity Management - REMOTE - 1821
description:
Mainframe Senior Architect – Performance & Capacity Management - 1821

Position Tupe: Full-Time
Base Salary: $130,000–$150,000
U.S. Citizenship Required due to contractual/access requirements
Visa Sponsorship: Not available


Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced Mainframe Senior Architect specializing in IBM mainframe performance and capacity management. This is a highly technical, hands-on role responsible for maintaining and optimizing the performance, scalability, stability, and cost efficiency of a large IBM zEnterprise mainframe environment.

This position is approximately 80% IBM mainframe performance management and 20% capacity planning.

The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in IBM z/OS performance, real-time performance monitoring and tuning, Workload Manager (WLM), SMF/RMF data analysis, and large-scale Parallel Sysplex environments.

This person will analyze system and workload performance, identify and resolve bottlenecks, optimize resource utilization, and forecast future infrastructure requirements while balancing performance with cost.

Key Responsibilities
  • Monitor, analyze, troubleshoot, and optimize IBM z/OS mainframe performance across large, complex environments.
  • Perform real-time analysis of CPU, memory, storage, workload, and transaction performance.
  • Identify root causes of performance degradation and resolve bottlenecks during critical or high-volume processing periods.
  • Tune and optimize Workload Manager (WLM) policies and workload configurations.
  • Analyze and interpret SMF and RMF data to identify performance trends and opportunities for optimization.
  • Evaluate the performance impact of major mainframe workloads and subsystems, including Db2, CICS, IMS, and MQ.
  • Work within multi-LPAR and Parallel Sysplex environments.
  • Analyze general processor and zIIP utilization and configuration.
  • Perform capacity forecasting and modeling based on workload trends, business cycles, and anticipated growth.
  • Forecast future MIPS/MSU and infrastructure requirements.
  • Support mainframe cost optimization, including understanding IBM software pricing models and infrastructure costs.
  • Perform SCRT (Sub-Capacity Reporting Tool) processing and related analysis.
  • Develop reporting, dashboards, and performance analysis using tools such as SAS/MXG, Excel, OMEGAMON, IntelliMagic, REXX, and JCL.
  • Partner with application developers, database administrators, infrastructure teams, DevOps, and leadership to communicate performance findings and recommendations.
  • Develop preventative strategies to maintain system stability, availability, and low latency during peak workloads.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentoring in mainframe performance and capacity management.

Required Qualifications
  • Extensive hands-on experience with IBM mainframe performance management and tuning.
  • Strong expertise with IBM z/OS and IBM Z architecture.
  • Experience working in large multi-LPAR, Parallel Sysplex environments.
  • Deep knowledge of Workload Manager (WLM) configuration and tuning.
  • Strong experience analyzing SMF and RMF performance data.
  • Experience monitoring and optimizing CPU, memory, storage, and workload utilization.
  • Strong understanding of Db2, CICS, IMS, and MQ and how these workloads impact overall system performance.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex mainframe performance issues in real time.
  • Strong hands-on skills with REXX and JCL.
  • Experience with performance reporting and analytical tools such as SAS/MXG and OMEGAMON.
  • Strong knowledge of mainframe capacity concepts, including MIPS, MSUs, workload forecasting, and capacity modeling.
  • Understanding of IBM mainframe software pricing and cost optimization.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and the ability to present complex technical findings to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen.

Highly Preferred / Eye-Catcher
Grafana experience is highly desirable. Candidates who have used Grafana for performance monitoring, dashboards, visualization, or mainframe-related operational reporting will receive strong consideration.

Additional preferred experience includes:
  • ZPCR
  • Macro4 Freezeframe
  • BMC Thruput Manager
  • TADz
  • IntelliMagic
  • SAS programming for reporting and analytics
  • Creating executive dashboards and operational reporting tools
  • Highly transactional, large-scale enterprise environments

Education
A Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is desirable but not an absolute requirement.

Candidates without a Bachelor’s Degree may still be considered based on the strength and depth of their relevant IBM mainframe performance experience. If a candidate does not have a Bachelor’s Degree, this should be clearly noted when presenting the candidate.

Ideal Candidate Profile
The strongest candidate will be a true IBM mainframe performance specialist, rather than a general Mainframe Architect who has only had occasional exposure to performance or capacity management.
We are particularly interested in candidates who have spent significant portions of their careers actively:
  • Monitoring and tuning z/OS performance
  • Working with WLM, RMF, and SMF
  • Diagnosing real-time mainframe performance problems
  • Optimizing CPU and zIIP utilization
  • Working in Parallel Sysplex/multi-LPAR environments
  • Analyzing Db2, CICS, IMS, and MQ workloads
  • Using SAS/MXG, OMEGAMON, IntelliMagic, or similar performance tools
  • Forecasting MIPS/MSU and future capacity requirements
  • Balancing performance requirements against IBM mainframe infrastructure and software costs

description:

US BASED CANDIDATES ONLY.

This is a remote position requiring occasional onsite visits in Downtown and South Miami.

*No third parties and no sponsorship*

Who we are

Founded in 2009 and headquartered in beautiful Miami, FL, TECKpert is a tech consulting and staff augmentation firm. At TECKpert, we offer a contingent workforce built for any size digital transformation project. Experts in design, development, IT, analytics and marketing, provide innovative digital solutions to achieve success in our new economy. Our leaders identify the technical talent best suited to bolster our client’s capabilities, across all industries, including, healthcare, government, finance, legal, real estate, and startups.

The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise in IDMS, COBOL, JCL, and mainframe utilities, combined with strong analytical and communication skills.

  • Maintain and enhance IDMS database structures, screen mappings, and application logic.

  • Support application documentation and ensure adherence to established standards and procedures.
  • Collaborate with IT teams and end users to ensure reliable system performance and service delivery.

title: Lead Service Analyst - Hardware
description:
Description

Lead Service Analyst – Hardware
£42,000 to £49,000 plus great benefits (Work Level 6A)
Manchester city centre - in this role you’ll work in a hybrid way splitting your time between home and the office twice per week (find out more about our hybrid working policy at https://jobs.coop.co.uk/hybrid-working-policy).
We’re open to applications from people who may require flexible working arrangements. There’ll be an opportunity to discuss your flexible working requirements during the interview process, and at offer stage.

We’re reshaping our Digital, Technology and Data function for the future, creating new opportunities, strengthening our capability, and building clearer, more resilient ways of working so we can deliver even better services for our Co-op, our colleagues, members and customers.

We're looking for a Lead Service Analyst to join our Technology team and help us deliver reliable, high-performing services that support colleagues, customers and members across our Co-op. You'll use data, insight and service management expertise to help monitor service health, identify opportunities for improvement and support effective decision-making across a portfolio of critical technology services. Working closely with Service Managers, engineers, suppliers and stakeholders, you'll help ensure our services remain stable, resilient and fit for the future.

Why this role matters

In this role you’ll support the improvement of the hardware our colleagues rely on every day. From laptops and phones to scanners in our stores, you’ll play a key role in ensuring these services remain reliable, accessible and fit for the future. Using data and insight, you’ll help shape how we manage and improve our services, identifying trends, risks and opportunities that drive better performance and colleague experiences. You’ll also play a key role in managing supplier performance and financial governance, helping ensure our technology partners deliver on their commitments and that service costs are effectively managed, tracked and reported.

What you’ll do

• Analyse service performance data to identify trends, risks and opportunities for improvement across one or more technology services
• Support incident, problem and change management activities, providing insight and evidence to support decision-making and continuous improvement
• Produce and maintain service reporting, dashboards and performance insights for stakeholders and service reviews
• Work with Service Managers, technical teams and suppliers to improve service performance and operational effectiveness
• Monitor supplier performance, making sure Technology suppliers are delivering to contractual commitments and performance is tracked and reported on
• Support operational readiness and service transition activities, helping ensure new services and changes are ready to be supported in live environments
• Maintain accurate service records, documentation, knowledge articles and service catalogue information
• Manage supplier invoicing and Technology spend, ensuring robust financial governance, accurate tracking and reporting of costs, and timely approval of invoices

What you’ll bring
We’re committed to making our roles as accessible as possible, so we only ask for the minimum criteria. To thrive here, you’ll need to bring:
• Experience working within IT Service Management, Service Operations, Service Delivery or a similar technology environment
• Experience analysing data and identifying trends, risks and opportunities to improve service performance and customer outcomes
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear insights and recommendations
• Experience producing reports, dashboards or service performance information for a range of stakeholders
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across technical and non-technical teams
• Expert knowledge of Microsoft applications such as Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI and Co-Pilot, to enable efficient tracking and reporting capabilities
We know some people may hesitate to apply if they don’t meet every requirement. At Co-op, we’re committed to building diverse and inclusive teams, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly, we still encourage you to apply.

Why Co-op?
At Co-op, we’re owned by our members. And because we’re owned by you, we can do right by you. So when you join us, you’re not just taking a job, you’re joining a movement. We’re an organisation that puts people and communities first, and we’re powered by purpose. We want this to be a place where you can thrive, so you’ll also receive:

• An annual bonus (based on personal and business performance)
• 28 days holiday (rising to 32 with service) plus bank holidays
• A pension with up to 10% employer contributions
• Access to a subsidised onsite gym (at our Manchester HQ)
• 30% discount on Co-op products and 10% off other brands
• Stream – early access to a percentage of your pay as you earn it
• Virtual healthcare including GP appointments, mental health support, nutrition and fitness advice
• 24/7 colleague support service
• Training and support for your development and career progression
• Cycle-to-work scheme

A place you’ll belong

We’re building diverse and inclusive teams that reflect the communities we serve. We welcome applications from everyone and are committed to creating a workplace where colleagues can feel like they belong, supported by our inclusive policies and the ways we work.

We’re proud to be part of the Disability Confident scheme and offer interviews to disabled candidates who meet the minimum criteria for a job. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, we’ll support you.

Learn more about our recruitment process at jobs.coop.co.uk/apply-process and our inclusion commitments at jobs.coop.co.uk/diversity-inclusion

You will work directly with the Electronic Trading Lines of Business to ensure the technical strategy aligns with and accomplishes business goals, to develop solutions to compute engineering challenges, and to provide guidance and mentorship to partner technical teams. Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them.

The Principal Software Engineer owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems. This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production.

What You'll Own

  • Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives.

  • Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability.

  • Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans.

  • Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices.

  • Leading technically critical initiatives and mentoring engineers across teams.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep expertise in backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production.

  • Ability to make sound technical trade-offs, influence engineers and solve complex production problems.

Nice to have

  • Experience scaling engineering teams, systems or development practices through significant growth.

  • Experience operating across multiple products, markets or countries.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Director, National Accounts
description:
About Us:

How many companies can say they have been in business for over 178 years?!

Here at ZEISS, we certainly can! As the pioneers of science, ZEISS handles the ever-changing environments in a fast-paced world, meeting it with cutting edge technologies and continuous advancements. ZEISS believes that innovation and technology are the key to a sustainable future and solutions for global change. We have a diverse range of portfolios throughout the ZEISS family in segments like Industrial Quality & Research, Medical Technology, Consumer Markets and Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology. We are a global company with over 42,000 employees and have over 4,000 in the US and Canada alone! Make a difference, come join the team!

What’s the role?

Reporting to VP/SVP, Retail, the National Account Director is responsible for the overall revenue, profit, operating expense, and account management for the assigned national/global retail account(s) within the U.S. Retail Business. The Director will cover the full range of retail relationship across all business segments including: Lab Rx Services, Lens Substrate, Dispensing Tools and Instruments, AR Coatings, Lens Accessories and Lab Enablement Services across ZEISS Branded, non-branded and OEM product portfolios. The Director will seek to increase CZV revenue, volume, profit and share of wallet by developing annual business plans and value-added programs and services that uniquely meet the needs of the retail key account. The goal is to strengthen and grow partnerships with retailers and partners while accelerating market share. The Director will seek to develop a strong, high performing team by championing the ZEISS Values (Serve, Act, Empower, Win) and implementing ZEISS leadership principles.

Sound Interesting?

Here’s what you’ll do:

National Retail Partnerships

  • Oversee ZEISS’s partnership with key accounts, including contract negotiation, assortment planning, pricing, and execution of joint business initiatives.

  • Manage current national customers

  • Pursue and develop potential partnerships with new customers

  • Conduct quarterly business reviews with leadership on key accounts to evaluate performance, growth opportunities, and collaboration plans.

Strategic Growth & Execution

  • Develop and lead a unified retail growth strategy that balances scale with ZEISS’s premium brand positioning.

  • Meet and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets as communicated by VP/SVP/President.

  • Initiate, organize and facilitate business activities between CZV and National Accounts including quarterly/annual business review and business plans.

  • Develop and deliver high impact, customer relevant, and financially supported proposals and presentations

  • Ensure clear roles and responsibilities across all direct/indirect reports; provide ongoing and continuous performance feedback (informal and formal)

  • Develop and plan key product initiatives and go-to-market programs to achieve customer objectives and CZV revenue/profit targets. Inclusive of RFP’s and pricing strategies.

  • Prepare sales and volume forecasts to support budget and demand planning cycles and provide timely input to VP to ensure plans are on track

  • Gather and analyze competitive data; Communicate findings and recommendations.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Marketing including the development of co-branded consumer campaigns emphasizing ZEISS lens innovation and quality.

  • Coordinate with Operations and Supply Chain to ensure optimal product availability, pricing accuracy, service levels, and inventory turns.

  • Collaborate with Product and Digital teams to embed ZEISS technologies within retail environments.

  • Manage office facilities and administration (if applicable)

  • Follows safety standards and reports any safety concerns to leadership

Do you qualify?

  • Minimum of 5-10 years’ account management experience in the ophthalmic industry leading large retail accounts; Experience in CPG or related consumer products industry will be considered.

  • Must have direct experience working for or calling on customers at the VP or Sr. Director level with relationships among key customer decision makers.

  • Must have experience in an FDA-approved, highly regulated product category (e.g., consumer healthcare such as OTC medicines, diabetes test strips, or blood pressure monitors).

  • Proven success developing strategies that enable others to win new business and expand market share.

  • Demonstrated success managing RFP processes under tight timelines.

  • Proven history of complex negotiations yielding long-term, mutually beneficial partnerships.

  • High integrity and discernment—able to evaluate and decline opportunities inconsistent with brand or ethical standards.

  • Experience in global organizations and cross-cultural collaboration.

Nice to have

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Senior DataOps / Cloud Data Engineer
description:

We are seeking a Senior DataOps / Cloud Data Engineer to support a large public‑sector data modernization initiative in Toronto. The successful candidate will design, develop, optimize, and support cloud‑based data pipelines and lakehouse solutions using Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Informatica, Python, and SQL.

This is a highly hands-on role focused on data integration, ETL/ELT development, Medallion Architecture, data migration, pipeline orchestration, automation, and DataOps.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and optimize Azure Data Factory and Databricks pipelines from Oracle and other on-premises data sources to cloud Lakehouse environments.
  • Develop and implement solutions using Databricks Medallion Architecture and Delta Lake.
  • Design and optimize relational, dimensional, and enterprise data models.
  • Translate existing Informatica ETL processes into Azure Data Factory and Databricks ELT solutions.
  • Develop data pipelines, workflows, jobs, scripts, and automation using Python, SQL, T-SQL, PL/SQL, ADF, Informatica, SSIS, and/or Microsoft Fabric.
  • Implement data orchestration, parallel processing, data movement, and pipeline automation.
  • Support large-scale data migration from OLTP/OLAP environments to cloud-based platforms.
  • Implement data quality, validation, profiling, cleansing, monitoring, and data governance practices.
  • Develop and maintain data lineage and documentation to provide traceability of data movement and transformations.
  • Support CI/CD, deployment automation, and data provisioning using tools such as Azure DevOps.
  • Troubleshoot production data pipeline issues and implement corrective solutions.
  • Work with technical teams, business stakeholders, and project teams to support solution design and integration.
  • Create technical and solution documentation, including data mappings, models, requirements, and design documentation.
  • Provide technical guidance and knowledge transfer to internal team members.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience as a Senior Data Engineer, Cloud Data Engineer, or DataOps Engineer.
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks, Azure Data Factory, and Informatica.
  • Strong development experience with Python and SQL, including T-SQL and/or PL/SQL.
  • Experience designing and implementing Databricks Medallion Architecture.
  • Strong knowledge of Delta Lake and Lakehouse architecture.
  • Experience developing and managing enterprise data pipelines and workflows.
  • Experience with ETL/ELT development, orchestration, automation, and deployment.
  • Experience integrating cloud platforms with on-premises databases and data sources, particularly Oracle.
  • Experience with data warehousing, data lakes, lakehouses, dimensional modelling, fact/dimension models, and star schemas.
  • Experience with CI/CD and Azure DevOps.
  • Experience working with large and complex datasets and high-volume data environments.
  • Experience with data quality, data governance, data lineage, and data security practices.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Experience working in Agile and/or Waterfall environments.

title: UE5 Technical Lead
description:
What are you working on?
  • The name of the project(s): Project T
  • At what stage of the project(s)? Deveploment
  • Genres: Card and/or Board, Casual
  • Platforms: PC, Mobile

Who are you? How long have you been on the market?
EZ Street Studio is a new independent game studio focused on creating stylish, character-driven games with strong visual identities. We are currently building our first major title, Project T, with a growing international development team.

What are your main projects?
Our primary focus is Project T, an anime-style casual game set in a vibrant science-fiction universe. The project places a strong emphasis on memorable characters, expressive animation, stylish environments, and a polished visual presentation inspired by modern anime games.

What makes you stand out from other companies?
EZ Street Studio is being built around a small, focused development team. This gives our team members a level of creative ownership that can be difficult to find at larger studios. You won't simply be maintaining an existing pipeline — you'll have the opportunity to help build the technology, workflows, and visual standards that will define the project.

We are particularly focused on creating a distinctive anime visual style with high-quality materials, shaders, VFX, characters, and environments. For technical artists, this provides an opportunity to have a direct impact on how the game ultimately looks and feels.

Why is your company stable? If a candidate takes the risk, how will it pay off?
Project T has secured funding for development, allowing EZ Street Studio to continue building the project and expanding the team. We are growing deliberately, bringing in specialists as the project reaches the stages where their expertise can have the greatest impact.

Joining at this stage also means joining early enough to make a lasting contribution. Team members will have the opportunity to take ownership of important systems, establish production standards, and see their work directly influence the finished game.

What unique approaches/work methods do you use?
We believe in keeping development collaborative, direct, and focused on the quality of the final product. Our team is intentionally structured to avoid unnecessary layers of management and bureaucracy.

We encourage specialists to bring their own ideas and expertise to the table. Art and engineering work closely together rather than operating as completely separate departments, allowing us to iterate quickly and solve visual and technical problems together.

Company or product plans?
Our current priority is establishing the foundation of Project T — its visual identity, technology, core systems, production pipeline, and development team.

As development progresses, we plan to expand the game's characters, world, environments, content, and visual technology while continuing to grow EZ Street Studio around talented specialists. Our long-term goal is to establish the studio as a developer known for stylish, polished, character-focused games with strong art direction and distinctive worlds

For which tasks (responsibilities)?

Responsibilities

What is the main business purpose of this role?
The Technical Artist will be responsible for developing and maintaining the Unity rendering, material, and shader technology that supports Project T's anime-inspired visual style. The role will bridge the art and engineering teams, ensuring assets achieve the desired visual quality while remaining performant and scalable.

Which tasks will a specialist have to solve?

  • Develop and maintain custom cel-shaded and anime-style shaders in Unity.

  • Create and maintain reusable materials and shader systems for characters, environments, props, and VFX.

  • Develop stylized rendering features such as rim lighting, gradients, outlines, fresnel effects, emission, and other anime-inspired techniques.

  • Create materials for different surfaces including skin, hair, clothing, metals, glass, holograms, energy, and other sci-fi elements.

  • Work with artists to integrate materials and shaders into production assets.

  • Identify and resolve rendering, material, and shader issues.

  • Optimize shaders and materials for target platforms.

  • Profile GPU/rendering performance and identify bottlenecks.

  • Establish technical standards and workflows for materials and shaders.

  • Build reusable tools and workflows that allow artists to work efficiently without requiring constant technical assistance.

  • Collaborate closely with programmers, 3D artists, VFX artists, and art leadership.

  • Research and implement new rendering techniques that can improve the game's visual quality.

Responsibilities?

  • Own the technical implementation of the project's material and shader pipeline.

  • Help establish and maintain the game's visual rendering style.

  • Ensure the cel-shaded/anime aesthetic remains consistent across different assets and environments.

  • Balance visual quality with performance and memory requirements.

  • Support artists in solving technical problems with their assets.

  • Document material and shader workflows where appropriate.

  • Maintain clean, reusable, and scalable shader systems.

  • Participate in visual reviews and provide technical recommendations.

  • Help develop new rendering features as the project evolves.

What are the key KPIs?

  • Quality and consistency of the game's anime/cel-shaded rendering.

  • Successful implementation of required materials and shader features.

  • Shader and material performance on target hardware.

  • Reduction of rendering-related issues and technical blockers for the art team.

  • Reusability and scalability of the material/shader pipeline.

  • Ability to deliver technical solutions within production deadlines.

  • Effective collaboration between the technical art, art, and engineering teams.

What kind of professional are we looking for?

Professional Skills

What experience is required?

  • Professional experience as a Technical Artist, preferably with a focus on materials, shaders, and rendering.

  • Proven experience working with Unity and production game projects.

  • Experience creating and implementing cel-shaded, toon, or anime-style rendering.

  • Experience developing custom materials and shaders for real-time applications.

  • Experience working closely with both artists and programmers.

What kind of skills do you need?

  • Strong understanding of real-time rendering and the graphics pipeline.

  • Strong understanding of PBR and stylized/anime rendering workflows.

  • Ability to create and optimize custom shaders and materials.

  • Understanding of lighting, shadows, normals, UVs, textures, transparency, emission, and post-processing.

  • Ability to troubleshoot visual and technical rendering problems.

  • Strong optimization skills, particularly GPU and shader performance.

  • Ability to turn artistic requirements into practical technical solutions.

  • Good communication and collaboration skills.

What program/tools/language knowledge is required?

  • Unity — required.

  • Shader Graph — required.

  • HLSL — required or strong working knowledge.

  • URP — required.

  • Git or another version-control system.

  • Familiarity with Substance 3D Painter/Designer.

  • Familiarity with Blender, Maya, or another 3D package.

  • Experience with Unity's Frame Debugger and/or GPU profiling tools is highly desirable.

What English level is required and for what?

  • Intermediate English or higher (B1–B2+).

What's a plus for a candidate?

  • Experience developing anime, cel-shaded, or stylized games.

  • Experience working on mobile or cross-platform games.

  • Experience with sci-fi materials and visual effects such as holograms, energy, force fields, holographic interfaces, and emissive materials.

  • Experience creating custom toon-lighting models or outline systems.

  • Experience with Unity's Scriptable Render Pipeline and custom rendering features.

  • Strong GPU optimization and profiling experience.

  • Experience building Unity editor tools or technical art tools.

  • Experience working on live-service games.

  • A strong technical art portfolio demonstrating custom shaders, materials, and real-time rendering work.

What is important for us in a person?

What competencies do you need?

  • Ownership — You take responsibility for the systems you work on and see them through from implementation to polish.

  • Problem-solving — You can investigate problems independently, identify solutions, and ask for help when necessary.

  • Communication — You communicate clearly, raise concerns early, and keep the team informed of your progress.

  • Collaboration — You work comfortably with programmers, designers, artists, and technical leadership.

  • Adaptability — You are comfortable working in an evolving project where ideas and systems may change as the game develops.

  • Attention to detail — You care about responsiveness, game feel, performance, and the small details that make gameplay feel polished.

  • Initiative — You don't wait for someone to tell you every step. You identify problems and opportunities and take action.

  • Critical thinking — You are comfortable questioning a design or technical approach when you believe there is a better solution.

  • Reliability — You communicate honestly about progress, challenges, and deadlines.

What kind of behavior is welcomed and encouraged in the company?

We value people who are proactive, honest, collaborative, and passionate about making games.

We encourage team members to speak up, share ideas, challenge assumptions respectfully, and participate in decisions that affect their work. We don't expect everyone to agree on everything; healthy debate is part of creating a better game.

Because we're a small team, everyone has an impact. We expect team members to respect each other's expertise, communicate openly, help one another when needed, and take pride in the quality of what they build.

Most importantly, we want people who genuinely want to make the game better.

Why do we enjoy working here?

Creative freedom and realization

We want our team members to have a real voice in the development process. You won't simply be executing predefined tasks, you'll have the opportunity to propose ideas, experiment with solutions, and contribute to how gameplay systems are designed and implemented.

The ability to influence the product

Project T is being built from the ground up, which means early team members can have a significant impact on the final game. Your decisions and contributions can directly influence gameplay systems, technical solutions, and the overall player experience.

Clear management

We believe in direct, transparent communication. The team will work closely with the Creative Director with clear priorities and expectations. We want everyone to understand not only what they're building, but why they're building it.

Professional development atmosphere

You'll work alongside experienced developers in a collaborative environment where knowledge sharing is encouraged. We want team members to expand their skills, take on new challenges, and grow alongside the project.

Professional development system

As the studio grows, we intend to establish structured opportunities for professional development, including increased responsibilities, mentorship, exposure to different areas of development, and opportunities to specialize or take ownership of major systems.

Regular constructive feedback

We believe feedback should be continuous rather than something that only happens during formal reviews. Team members will receive regular feedback through development discussions, code reviews, playtesting, and one-on-one conversations.

Our goal is constructive feedback, not micromanagement, helping people understand what is working, what can be improved, and how they can continue growing.

What are the conditions and bonuses?

Holidays
All standard national holidays are paid days off. The specific holiday calendar will be communicated during onboarding.

Paid Sick Days
We provide 14 paid personal days that can be used for illness, personal matters, appointments, or other needs.

Work Schedule
We offer flexible working hours. Team members are expected to maintain reasonable availability for team communication, meetings, and collaboration while otherwise having flexibility in how they structure their workday.

Remote Work
100% remote. You can work from your preferred location. EZ Street Gaming will never require you to relocate for this position.

Monetary Bonuses

The selection process

What stages of the interview and with whom?

Our process is designed to be straightforward and respectful of your time:

  1. Application Review — We review your CV, portfolio, and relevant experience.

  2. Initial Interview — A conversation with the Creative Director to discuss your experience, interests, and what you're looking for in your next project.

  3. Final Interview — A final conversation with the team to make sure the role, project, and working style are a good fit for both sides.

Will there be a test task?

A small technical task may be requested depending on the candidate's experience and portfolio. If requested, it will be focused on relevant gameplay programming skills and designed to be reasonable in scope. We do not expect candidates to complete a large unpaid project.

How fast is the decision?

We aim to move quickly. Candidates can generally expect an initial response within a few business days, with a final decision shortly after completing the interview process.

What's the emphasis in the cover letter?

Keep it concise. We'd primarily like to know:

  • Why you're interested in Project T / EZ Street Gaming

  • Why gameplay programming is the area you're passionate about

  • Your experience with Unity, Materials, and Shaders.

  • Any shipped games or projects you're particularly proud of

  • What you're looking for in your next team

We'd rather hear why you want to make this kind of game than receive a generic cover letter describing your entire career.
